最近邻哈伯德模型的精确图解量子蒙特卡罗 (DiagMC) 结果激发了对赝能隙的更深入研究。使用改进的双粒子自洽方法 (TPSC+)，我们同时分析能量 (EDC) 和动量分布曲线 (MDC)。我们证明了费米液体术语在赝能隙状态下被打破，需要区分真费米表面和假费米表面以及零能量准粒子（ZEQ）线。假费米面具有动量空间谱最大值，但在零能量处频率空间凹陷，而假 ZEQ 线违反了标准准粒子条件 $\partial \Sigma'(\mathbf{k},\omega)/\partial \omega|_{\omega=0}<0$。赝能隙由临界热自旋涨落驱动，由于 Mermin-Wagner 定理，热自旋涨落发生在二维中。相应的波动首先打开一个波腹赝能隙，留下真正的费米弧。随着温度降低，费米面演变成类空穴和电子的假费米面。

不相称的涨落会在对角线附近产生热点，其中赝能隙持续到量子临界点（QCP），而在 $\mathbf{k}_{AN}$ 处，赝能隙在 QCP 掺杂之前消失。在那里，光谱有两个前体反铁磁 (AFM) 谱带，均位于未占据 ($\omega>0$) 区域。我们将 TPSC+ 与松原光谱代理 $-\mathrm{Im}[\mathcal{G}(\mathbf{k},i\pi T)]/\pi$ 的 DiagMC 结果进行基准测试。 TPSC+ 低估了强相互作用状态下的赝能隙抑制，在较低温度或掺杂下再现了 DiagMC 行为。该代理相当于具有热展宽的谱函数 $\eta=\pi T$，当 $\pi T$ 不是最小能量尺度时，它会模糊特征。使用$A(\mathbf{k},0)$，我们发现在低温下任何相互作用强度下，甚至在弱耦合下，都会出现类孔费米面。

title: Constructing Large and Structured Decoherence-Free Subspaces in Hybrid Quantum Systems
abstract: We develop a framework to construct large decoherence-free subspaces with a non-trivial structure. The construction is based on hybrid quantum systems in which quantum matter is coupled to a dissipative bosonic mode. Dissipation imposes a global constraint on the matter by selecting the matter null states in the long-time limit. The decoherence-free subspaces spanned by matter null states can exhibit exotic quantum properties and emergent symmetries that do not characterize the full Liouvillian dynamics. We show how to construct many-body operators with physically interesting null states by employing representation theory of Lie algebras. This approach allows us to choose models based on their underlying algebraic structure. We consider explicitly the example of coupling a lossy optical cavity to the directed tunneling operator of quantum particles in one-dimension. In this case, the symmetries of the decoherence-free subspace originate in an $\mathfrak{sl}(2,\mathbb{C})$ algebra, leading to an exponentially large number of steady states. We characterize the null states for both fermionic and bosonic particles, employing analytical and numerical methods. The states exhibit several properties that underline their complex quantum nature: long-range kinetic correlations and volume-law entanglement. The nonreciprocal nature of the directed tunneling dynamics leads to the emergence in the many-body regime of a symmetry-constrained Liouvillian skin effect. The open light-matter system exhibits a strong symmetry stemming from spinless $\eta$-pairing algebras. We show how the non-trivial properties of the long-times states emerge in the dissipative dynamics from generic initial states, by performing time-dependent matrix product state simulations. Our framework opens avenues for dissipatively engineering complex quantum correlations and harnessing nonreciprocity in a controlled manner.
summary:
我们开发了一个框架来构造具有非平凡结构的大型无退相干子空间。该结构基于混合量子系统，其中量子物质与耗散玻色子模式耦合。耗散通过在长时间限制内选择物质零状态来对物质施加全局约束。由物质零态跨越的无退相干子空间可以表现出奇特的量子特性和涌现的对称性，而这些特性并不表征完整的刘维尔动力学。我们展示了如何通过采用李代数的表示理论来构造具有物理上有趣的零状态的多体算子。这种方法允许我们根据模型的底层代数结构来选择模型。我们明确考虑将有损光学腔耦合到一维量子粒子的定向隧道算子的示例。在这种情况下，无退相干子空间的对称性源自 $\mathfrak{sl}(2,\mathbb{C})$ 代数，导致稳态数量呈指数级增长。我们采用分析和数值方法来表征费米子和玻色子粒子的零态。

这些态表现出多种特性，强调了它们复杂的量子本质：长程动力学相关性和体积定律纠缠。定向隧道动力学的非互易性质导致多体体系中出现对称约束的刘维尔集肤效应。开放的光物质系统表现出源自无自旋 $\eta$ 配对代数的强对称性。通过执行瞬态矩阵乘积状态模拟，我们展示了长时间状态的非平凡属性如何在通用初始状态的耗散动力学中出现。我们的框架为耗散工程复杂的量子相关性和以受控方式利用非互易性开辟了途径。

title: Lyapunov spectrum of random neural networks
abstract: The Lyapunov spectrum of a nonlinear recurrent neural network with random asymmetric couplings is calculated in the limit $N\to\infty$. The calculation is based on a finite-$N$ identity that expresses the cumulative distribution of Lyapunov exponents as a response function of the tangent-space dynamics, with the tangent trajectory selected by a minimum-norm condition rather than by an initial condition. A cavity method then determines this response function at large $N$ through a self-consistent single-site problem. This result establishes that the chaos in this network is extensive and gives access to diffeomorphism-invariant properties of the dynamics. This work was done in collaboration with the AI models GPT-6 Astra and Claude Opus 5.5.
summary: 具有随机不对称耦合的非线性循环神经网络的李亚普诺夫谱在 $N\to\infty$ 极限下计算。该计算基于有限 $N$ 恒等式，该恒等式将 Lyapunov 指数的累积分布表示为切线空间动力学的响应函数，其中切线轨迹由最小范数条件而不是初始条件选择。然后，空腔方法通过自洽单点问题确定大 $N$ 的响应函数。这一结果表明，该网络中的混沌是广泛的，并且可以获取动力学的微分同胚不变特性。这项工作是与 AI 模型 GPT-6 Astra 和 Claude Opus 5.5 合作完成的。

title: Short-Range Vector Spin Glasses: Parisi Hierarchies and Real-Space Ultrametricity
abstract: Replica symmetry breaking (RSB) is the organizing principle of mean-field spin-glass theory, yet whether a continuous Parisi hierarchy can arise in a genuinely short-range system in finite spatial dimension remains unresolved. Here we introduce a disordered model of $N$-component vector spins on a $D$-dimensional hypercubic lattice, with random matrix couplings on nearest-neighbor links and random tensor couplings on elementary plaquettes. In the large-$N$ limit, the model supports thermodynamically stable one-step, full, and one-full RSB phases, alongside replica-symmetric paramagnetic and ferromagnetic phases. We find that spatial locality constrains these ordered phases through two distinct infrared mechanisms. ($i$) Quenched random anisotropy destroys uniform ferromagnetism for $D\leq4$ through an Imry-Ma mechanism. ($ii$) A continuous Parisi hierarchy gives rise to replica Goldstone modes whose gaplessness is protected by a Ward identity. At leading order in $1/N$, these modes behave as a band of free spin waves, producing infrared-divergent fluctuations in $D\leq2$ and a Mermin-Wagner instability of the continuously broken phase. Remarkably, the Parisi hierarchy also acquires a direct real-space interpretation. For two pure states with mutual overlap $q$, a characteristic length $\xi(q)$ describes how far the differences between their frozen magnetization patterns remain correlated. Throughout a continuous sector of the Parisi hierarchy, $\xi(q)$ is independent of temperature and decreases monotonically with $q$. The ultrametric organization of pure states is therefore accompanied by an ultrametric hierarchy of real-space correlation lengths: states that separate near the root of the Parisi tree differ through long-wavelength frozen patterns, whereas states that separate farther from the root differ only on progressively shorter scales.
summary:
复制对称破缺（RSB）是平均场自旋玻璃理论的组织原理，但在有限空间维度的真正短程系统中是否可以出现连续的 Parisi 层次结构仍然悬而未决。在这里，我们引入了 $D$ 维超立方晶格上 $N$ 分量向量自旋的无序模型，在最近邻链接上具有随机矩阵耦合，在基本斑块上具有随机张量耦合。在大 $N$ 限制下，该模型支持热力学稳定的一步、全和一全 RSB 相，以及复制对称顺磁和铁磁相。我们发现空间局部性通过两种不同的红外机制限制这些有序相。 ($i$) 淬火随机各向异性通过 Imry-Ma 机制破坏 $D\leq4$ 的均匀铁磁性。 ($ii$) 连续的帕里西等级制度产生了复制品戈德斯通模式，其无间隙性受到沃德身份的保护。在 $1/N$ 的前导阶上，这些模式表现为自由自旋波带，在 $D\leq2$ 中产生红外发散波动以及连续破碎相的 Mermin-Wagner 不稳定性。

值得注意的是，帕里西层次结构也获得了直接的真实空间解释。对于两个相互重叠 $q$ 的纯态，特征长度 $\xi(q)$ 描述了它们的冻结磁化模式之间的差异保持相关的程度。在 Parisi 层次结构的连续扇区中，$\xi(q)$ 与温度无关，并且随 $q$ 单调递减。因此，纯态的超度量组织伴随着实空间相关长度的超度量层次结构：在 Parisi 树根附近分离的态通过长波长冻结模式而不同，而远离根分离的态仅在逐渐较短的尺度上有所不同。

title: Closed Universe, Quantum Entanglement and Observers
abstract: It has been argued that in quantum gravity the Hilbert space associated with any closed universe is trivially one-dimensional. To reconcile this argument with the richness of our own universe, it was suggested that a nontrivial Hilbert space will emerge once an ``observer" is included. Such an ``observer" has been modeled in different ways. There are three concrete classes of models: $\textbf{1)}$ The ``observer" is modeled by a term in the full Hamiltonian of the system which is linear in a phase space variable; $\textbf{2)}$ The ``observer" is modeled in the quantum circuit model of holography as a subsystem in the closed universe which is entangled with an external non-gravitational system; $\textbf{3)}$ The ``observer" is argued to be described by the emergent Goldstone bosons when the diffeomorphisms are spontaneously broken. In fact, the third class was discovered by an attempt to physically realize the first class. In this paper, we will show that the second class can also be unified into the third class. Our result indicates that the emergence of the ``observer" is a manifestation of the $\textit{Massive Islands}$ paradigm. It demonstrates that the graviton mass is a feature of the quantum state. One should think of the islands as closed universes and the Goldstone boson associated with the graviton mass as the ``observer", which is exactly the case at late-times for evaporating black holes. An implication of this work is that the ``observer" can ``observe" global symmetries in quantum gravity.
summary:
有人认为，在量子引力中，与任何封闭宇宙相关的希尔伯特空间基本上都是一维的。为了使这一论点与我们宇宙的丰富性相一致，有人提出，一旦包含“观察者”，就会出现一个非平凡的希尔伯特空间。这样的“观察者”已经以不同的方式建模。模型分为三类： $\textbf{1)}$ “观察者”由系统的完整哈密顿量中的一项建模，该系统在相空间变量中呈线性； $\textbf{2)}$ 在全息术的量子电路模型中将“观察者”建模为封闭宇宙中的子系统，与外部非引力系统纠缠在一起； $\textbf{3)}$“观察者”被认为是由微分同胚自发破缺时出现的戈德斯通玻色子描述的。事实上，第三类是通过物理实现第一类的尝试而发现的。在本文中，我们将证明第二类也可以统一为第三类。我们的结果表明，“观察者”的出现是$\textit{Massive Island}$范式的体现。

它证明了引力子质量是量子态的一个特征。人们应该将这些岛屿视为封闭的宇宙，并将与引力子质量相关的戈德斯通玻色子视为“观察者”，这正是蒸发黑洞晚期的情况。这项工作的一个含义是，“观察者”可以“观察”量子引力中的全局对称性。

title: Thermodynamics of interacting magnetic chain molecules
abstract: We study magnets composed of molecules with an arbitrary number $m$ of magnetically active atoms in a chain configuration interacting with nearest-neighbor couplings. We derive the thermodynamics of a chain of spin-$j$ $SU(2)$ magnetic atoms using a mean-field approach and determine the equilibrium states and stability conditions. The system exhibits a rich phase structure with a cascade of ferromagnetic phase transitions, their number ranging from $m$, for maximal ferromagnets, to zero, for paramagnets, depending on the relative strengths of the couplings. In the presence of impurities (modified couplings) at the ends of the chain, boundary states emerge that coexist with the paramagnetic phase or the fully ferromagnetic phase. For long chains, a continuum approximation can be taken that clarifies the structure of the phases. In the continuum description, magnetized states at temperatures lower than the critical temperature at which they appear correspond to kink solitons.
summary: 我们研究由具有任意数量 $m$ 磁性活性原子的分子组成的磁体，这些原子呈链结构，与最近邻耦合相互作用。我们使用平均场方法推导了自旋 $j$ $SU(2)$ 磁性原子链的热力学，并确定了平衡状态和稳定条件。该系统表现出丰富的相结构，具有一系列铁磁相变，其数量范围从 $m$（最大铁磁体）到零（顺磁体），具体取决于耦合的相对强度。当链末端存在杂质（改性耦合）时，会出现与顺磁相或全铁磁相共存的边界态。对于长链，可以采用连续体近似来阐明相的结构。在连续统描述中，磁化态在低于临界温度的温度下出现，对应于扭结孤子。

title: Prescriptive Master Integrals of Maximal Weight at Two Loops
abstract: We describe the construction of a spanning set of individually pure, planar master integrals involving massless particles in four dimensions which include all maximal-weight contributions at two loops. In this basis, every independent region associated with infrared divergence is individually matched by specific masters, with all other masters being manifestly finite in four dimensions.
summary: 我们描述了一组跨度的单独纯平面主积分的构造，涉及四个维度的无质量粒子，其中包括两个循环中的所有最大重量贡献。在此基础上，与红外发散相关的每个独立区域都由特定的主控单独匹配，而所有其他主控在四个维度上显然是有限的。

title: Gluons and Knots
abstract: We argue that the scattering amplitude of a single minus helicity gluon with arbitrarily many positive helicity gluons is topological. The amplitude is constant in chambers of kinematic space, its resonances are located at walls and its factorization is determined by wall-crossing. Yangian invariance dictates the amplitude to be determined by a 2d null Wilson loop that can be lifted into a positive and transverse 3d link. By reinterpreting wall-crossing and the Weinberg soft theorem as skein relations and Reidemeister moves of the subknots, we construct a state-counting description consisting of adding the `corners' of their HOMFLY-PT polynomials. Beyond the classical limit, we argue that this provides a conjectured but precise connection to topological field and string theory. The new formula is rigorously derived via a Lean-formalized dependency graph (DAG) as detailed in a companion paper, laying out the precise assumptions including Reidemeister III invariance. It is further tested exhaustively, including novel `star' kinematics where the amplitude and state count are shown to become Catalan numbers, in agreement with knot theory literature.
summary: 我们认为单个负螺旋胶子与任意多个正螺旋胶子的散射幅度是拓扑的。运动空间室中的振幅是恒定的，其共振位于墙壁处，其分解由墙壁交叉决定。 Yangian 不变性决定了由 2d 零威尔逊环确定的振幅，该环可以提升为正横向 3d 链接。通过将穿墙和温伯格软定理重新解释为绞纱关系和子结的 Reidemeister 移动，我们构建了一个状态计数描述，包括添加 HOMFLY-PT 多项式的“角”。超越经典极限，我们认为这提供了与拓扑场和弦理论的推测但精确的联系。新公式是通过精益形式化依赖图 (DAG) 严格推导出来的，如配套论文中所述，提出了包括 Reidemeister III 不变性在内的精确假设。它被进一步详尽地测试，包括新颖的“星”运动学，其中振幅和状态计数显示为加泰罗尼亚数，与结理论文献一致。

title: Hawking Amplitudes: Subtle Points About Saddle Points
abstract: Hawking amplitudes provide a new way of determining the Hawking spectrum of black holes, using on-shell techniques borrowed from the literature on scattering amplitudes. In this paper, we investigate the interplay between the semi-classical and weak-field approximations previously used to compute Hawking amplitudes. We find that these limits do not necessarily commute, highlighting subtleties with the saddle point analyses governing the semi-classical limit. Resolving these issues allows us to compute semi-classical Hawking amplitudes in a range of black-hole backgrounds, including Tangherlini, Reissner-Nordström, and Hernquist metrics. Moreover, we describe the saddle-point contributions dominating Hawking amplitudes for different energies and propose a new method for determining the temperature of the resulting thermal spectrum based on Stokes lines of Hawking amplitudes.
summary: 霍金振幅提供了一种确定黑洞霍金谱的新方法，使用从散射振幅文献中借用的壳上技术。在本文中，我们研究了先前用于计算霍金振幅的半经典近似和弱场近似之间的相互作用。我们发现这些极限不一定可以交换，这凸显了控制半经典极限的鞍点分析的微妙之处。解决这些问题使我们能够计算一系列黑洞背景中的半经典霍金振幅，包括 Tangherlini、Reissner-Nordström 和 Hernquist 度量。此外，我们描述了不同能量下主导霍金振幅的鞍点贡献，并提出了一种基于霍金振幅的斯托克斯线确定所得热谱温度的新方法。

title: Covariant BCFW for All Masses
abstract: We use the massive spinor-helicity formalism to describe a novel construction for massive spinors which allows one to connect the many choices of bases useful in the representation of amplitudes involving massive particles, and we use this to derive a new formulation for the general BCFW shift that is valid regardless whether or which of the particles involved are massive or massless. This formalism should help facilitate a more coherent implementation of on-shell recursion for computing amplitudes involving massive particles in four dimensions.
summary: 我们使用大质量自旋螺旋形式来描述大质量旋量的一种新颖结构，它允许人们连接在涉及大质量粒子的振幅表示中有用的多种基选择，并且我们用它来推导一般 BCFW 位移的新公式，无论所涉及的粒子是质量还是无质量，该公式都是有效的。这种形式主义应该有助于促进壳递归的更连贯的实现，以计算涉及四个维度的大质量粒子的振幅。

title: General Spin-1 Dynamics During Inflation: Microcausality Constraints and Cosmological Collider Signals
abstract: We construct the general theory of a spin-1 field propagating on an inflationary background consistent with scale invariance, rotations, Bunch-Davies conditions and microcausality. Our Boostless Proca theory generalises the usual massive Proca theory to a Lagrangian with 5 free parameters: 4 corresponding to parity-even terms and a single parity-odd term. We impose three degrees of freedom from the outset and find that microcausality, the statement that field operators vanish outside the lightcone, requires the kinetic terms to be gauge invariant. We couple this spin-1 state to the inflaton and study the signatures it imprints on cosmological correlators. We find no new signals for the bispectrum meaning that the known signals are the most general thereby providing a very clean model-independent probe of new physics in this leading form of non-Gaussianity. For the trispectrum and higher-point functions, the boostless Proca theory produces new shapes with all 5 parameters in principle measurable.
summary: 我们构建了在暴胀背景下传播的自旋 1 场的一般理论，该理论与尺度不变性、旋转、Bunch-Davies 条件和微观因果关系一致。我们的 Boostless Proca 理论将通常的大规模 Proca 理论推广为具有 5 个自由参数的拉格朗日：4 个对应于奇偶校验项和一个奇偶校验项。我们从一开始就施加了三个自由度，并发现微观因果关系（场算子在光锥之外消失的陈述）要求动力学项是规范不变的。我们将这种自旋 1 态与暴胀子耦合起来，并研究它在宇宙学相关器上留下的特征。我们没有发现双谱的新信号，这意味着已知信号是最普遍的，从而以这种非高斯性的主要形式提供了一种非常干净的、独立于模型的新物理探测。对于三谱和高点函数，无助推 Proca 理论可生成原则上所有 5 个参数均可测量的新形状。

title: Scattering entanglement entropy between one particle species and the others
abstract: We construct the entanglement entropy of a general scattering process between one particle species (denoted as $A$) and the rest of the final state. Assuming a pure initial momentum eigenstate, we show that the reduced density matrix in particle $A$'s Fock space is block-diagonal in zero-, one- and multi-particle states, and is diagonal in the momentum basis for the one-particle state. As a result, we could write down the Von Neumann entropy of particle $A$, $S_A$, in terms of scattering probabilities and differential cross sections, assuming no more than one particle $A$ is produced in the final state. $S_A$ contains the information of both the total scattering probabilities (or cross sections) and the differential distributions --- the latter depends on a phase-space resolution factor as a result of the infinite-dimensional momentum Hilbert space. Our result is general and model-independent since we consider the full final state from time evolution ($S|i\rangle$) rather than a specific outcome, and is applicable as long as the probability for producing multiple particle $A$ is subleading. We also obtain the $n\geq2$ Tsallis and Rényi entropies in our framework and find out that, at the leading order, they are proportional to the total scattering probability and carry no differential information.
summary:
我们构建了一种粒子种类（表示为 $A$）与其余最终状态之间的一般散射过程的纠缠熵。假设纯初始动量本征态，我们证明粒子 $A$ 的 Fock 空间中的约化密度矩阵在零、一和多粒子态下是块对角的，并且在单粒子态的动量基础上是对角的。因此，我们可以根据散射概率和微分横截面写出粒子 $A$、$S_A$ 的冯诺依曼熵，假设在最终状态下产生的粒子 $A$ 不超过一个。 $S_A$ 包含总散射概率（或横截面）和微分分布的信息——后者取决于无限维动量希尔伯特空间的相空间分辨率因子。我们的结果是通用的并且与模型无关，因为我们考虑的是时间演化的完整最终状态 ($S|i\rangle$) 而不是特定的结果，并且只要产生多个粒子 $A$ 的概率是次领先的，它就适用。

我们还在我们的框架中获得了 $n\geq2$ Tsallis 和 Rényi 熵，并发现，在前导阶上，它们与总散射概率成正比，并且不携带差分信息。

title: Large Charge Jets in $\mathcal{N}=4$ SYM Energy Correlators
abstract: We compute the energy-energy correlator in a state created by a heavy canonical operator of scaling dimension $\Delta_H$ in $\mathcal{N}=4$ $SU(N)$ SYM, at fixed $N$ and arbitrary values of the large charge 't Hooft coupling $\lambda \sim \Delta_H g_{\rm YM}^2$. The state created by the canonical operator triggers spontaneous breaking of conformal symmetry and the Higgs mechanism, with squared W-boson masses proportional to $\lambda$. We start with the known finite-coupling result for the underlying four-point function of local operators, perform the detector and Fourier transforms and express the resulting energy-energy correlator as an infinite OPE sum in the source-detector channel, which we then analyze both numerically and analytically. We show that the finite-coupling energy-energy correlator exhibits a hierarchy of distinct physical regimes as a function of $z=(1-\cos\theta)/2$, where $\theta$ is the angle between the detectors. A small-angle vacuum-dominated behavior at $z\ll\lambda^{-1}$ is followed by a non-monotonic medium-induced transient behavior at $\lambda z \sim1$. A large charge jet regime follows, where the energy-energy correlator displays a power-law behavior $\sim1/(\lambda z^3)$ for $\lambda^{-1}\lesssim z \lesssim \lambda^{-1/3}$, before approaching an angle-independent plateau at larger angles.
summary:
我们在 $\mathcal{N}=4$ $SU(N)$ SYM 中，在固定 $N$ 和大电荷 't Hooft 耦合 $\lambda \sim \Delta_H g_{\rm YM}^2$ 的任意值下，计算由缩放维度 $\Delta_H$ 的重规范算子创建的状态下的能量-能量相关器。正则算子创建的状态会触发共形对称性和希格斯机制的自发破缺，W 玻色子质量的平方与 $\lambda$ 成正比。我们从局部算子的底层四点函数的已知有限耦合结果开始，执行检测器和傅立叶变换，并将所得的能量-能量相关器表示为源-检测器通道中的无限 OPE 和，然后我们对其进行数值和解析分析。我们证明，有限耦合能量-能量相关器表现出不同物理状态的层次结构，作为 $z=(1-\cos\theta)/2$ 的函数，其中 $\theta$ 是探测器之间的角度。 $z\ll\lambda^{-1}$ 处的小角度真空主导行为之后是 $\lambda z \sim1$ 处的非单调介质引起的瞬态行为。

接下来是一个大的电荷射流状态，其中能量-能量相关器显示出幂律行为 $\sim1/(\lambda z^3)$ 对于 $\lambda^{-1}\lesssim z \lesssim \lambda^{-1/3}$，然后以更大的角度接近与角度无关的平台。

title: Reconstructing BPS String Charge Cone in 6d N=(1,0) Supergravity
abstract: The tensor branch of six-dimensional $\mathcal N=(1,0)$ supergravity is characterized by a spectrum of BPS strings charged under the two-form gauge fields. Their charges span a cone in the tensor charge lattice, whose extremal rays are generated by primitive BPS string charges that become tensionless at the boundaries of the tensor moduli space. We develop a systematic procedure, based entirely on effective field theory data, to reconstruct the primitive BPS string generators and thereby determine the complete closed BPS string cone of any 6d $(1,0)$ supergravity theory. The key ingredients are the universal {\it H}-string, which allows us to isolate a fixed sector determined by classified LST blocks and gauge anomaly data from the remaining gauge-neutral E-string sector, and a BPS refinement of the Completeness Conjecture that ensures population of the relevant charge rays. We further show that this reconstruction provides new constraints on the low-energy theory and can rule out candidate EFTs that pass all previously known local lattice and anomaly consistency conditions. Separately, for theories admitting geometric tensor bases, we explain how the same reconstruction determines the complete Mori cone of the corresponding Kähler surface.
summary:
六维 $\mathcal N=(1,0)$ 超重力的张量分支的特征是在两种形式的规范场下充电的 BPS 弦的频谱。它们的电荷跨越张量电荷晶格中的一个锥体，其极值射线是由原始 BPS 弦电荷产生的，这些电荷在张量模空间的边界处变得无张力。我们开发了一个完全基于有效场论数据的系统程序，以重建原始 BPS 弦生成器，从而确定任何 6d $(1,0)$ 超重力理论的完整闭合 BPS 弦锥。关键成分是通用的 {\it H} 串，它允许我们从剩余的规范中性 E 串扇区中分离出由分类 LST 块和规范异常数据确定的固定扇区，以及完整性猜想的 BPS 细化，确保相关电荷射线的填充。我们进一步表明，这种重建为低能理论提供了新的约束，并且可以排除通过所有先前已知的局部晶格和异常一致性条件的候选 EFT。

另外，对于承认几何张量基的理论，我们解释了相同的重构如何确定相应卡勒曲面的完整森锥。

title: All-multiplicity completion of maximally supersymmetric gauge amplitudes
abstract: We show that the known six-point constraints on four-point amplitudes are sufficient for completion at arbitrary multiplicity in planar, four-dimensional maximally supersymmetric gauge theory. We construct massless tree amplitudes as formal series in the derivative expansion, with the standard supersymmetric Yang-Mills three-point amplitudes, unbroken R-symmetry, and parity invariance of amplitudes with only external scalars, holding the scalar labels fixed. For a positive leading four-point contact coefficient, the even coefficients in the logarithmic parameterization are fixed, while every real sequence of odd coefficients is realized by a completion at all derivative orders. The construction uses the field-theory Kawai-Lewellen-Tye bilinear and normalized matrices of sphere integrals. Exponentiating homogeneous components of their matrix logarithms varies the odd coefficients independently while preserving locality and factorization through the complete massless multiplet. The six-point conditions are therefore necessary and sufficient for such a completion. Higher-multiplicity consistency imposes no further restrictions on these four-point coefficients once the higher-point contact interactions are chosen consistently with the same symmetries and factorization conditions.
summary:
我们证明，四点振幅的已知六点约束足以完成平面四维最大超对称规范理论中的任意多重性。我们将无质量树振幅构造为导数展开中的形式级数，具有标准超对称杨-米尔斯三点振幅、完整的 R 对称性以及仅具有外部标量的振幅奇偶不变性，保持标量标签固定。对于正的前导四点接触系数，对数参数化中的偶系数是固定的，而奇系数的每个实数序列是通过在所有导数阶上完成来实现的。该构造使用场论 Kawai-Lewellen-Tye 双线性和球积分的归一化矩阵。对矩阵对数的齐次分量取幂独立地改变奇系数，同时通过完整的无质量多重态保留局部性和因式分解。因此，六点条件是完成这一任务的充分必要条件。

一旦在相同的对称性和因式分解条件下一致地选择更高点的接触相互作用，更高的多重性一致性就不再对这些四点系数施加进一步的限制。

title: Generalised Gibbs Ensembles from the ODE/IM Correspondence: the Lee--Yang Model
abstract: We introduce a systematic scheme for constructing the ODE/IM counterpart of generalised Gibbs ensembles, and apply it to the chiral sector of the Lee--Yang conformal field theory. We encode the chemical potentials in a deformation of the cubic oscillator, fixed order by order by requiring that the large-energy WKB period reproduces exactly the driving term of the corresponding thermodynamic Bethe ansatz equation; the subleading WKB periods then yield, as predictions, the deformed eigenvalues of the local conserved charges. We work out the spin-5 ensemble in detail for two states of the model: the ground state, in the module of the primary $\phi$, dual to the deformed cubic oscillator, and the primary of the identity module, dual to the same oscillator supplemented by an apparent singularity, a double pole whose position is fixed by a trivial-monodromy condition. In both cases, the Stokes multiplier obeys the Lee--Yang Y-system, and the deformed eigenvalues match, to the orders checked, an independent conformal-field-theory computation. The Borel resummation of the resulting series for the ground-state energy reproduces the numerical TBA solution over many orders of magnitude in the chemical potential. The scheme relies only on general features of the ODE/IM correspondence and applies to generalised Gibbs ensembles in other integrable models.
summary:
我们介绍了构造广义吉布斯系综的 ODE/IM 对应部分的系统方案，并将其应用于 Lee-Yang 共形场论的手性部分。我们对立方振子变形中的化学势进行编码，通过要求大能量 WKB 周期精确再现相应热力学 Bethe ansatz 方程的驱动项来逐级固定；然后，作为预测，次主导 WKB 周期会产生局部守恒电荷的变形特征值。我们详细计算了模型的两个状态的自旋 5 系综：基态，在初级 $\phi$ 的模块中，与变形立方振荡器对偶，以及恒等模块的初级，与由表观奇点补充的同一振荡器对偶，其位置由平凡单态条件固定的双极点。在这两种情况下，斯托克斯乘子都遵循 Lee-Yang Y 系统，并且变形特征值与检查的阶数匹配，是独立的共形场理论计算。

所得基态能量系列的 Borel 恢复再现了化学势多个数量级的 TBA 数值解。该方案仅依赖于 ODE/IM 对应关系的一般特征，并适用于其他可积模型中的广义吉布斯系综。

title: Carroll-Weyl gauged null strings in AdS
abstract: We study the Carroll-Weyl gauged null string in the Poincaré patch of $\mathrm{AdS}_D$ and its BRST quantization. In Poincaré coordinates $X^A=(z,x^i)$, the radial conformal Killing vector $K=\partial_z$ becomes homothetic in a suitable conformally related frame. A field-dependent rescaling of the homothetic Hamiltonian constraint then leads to the radial-adapted basis $\mathcal{M}=\frac{1}{2}(P_z^2+P_iP^i)$, $\mathcal{L}=-P_AX'^A$, and $\mathcal{S}=P_z$, with $\mathcal{M}$ invariant along the Carroll-Weyl radial flow. Their modes form a $\mathrm{BMS}_3$ algebra extended by an abelian weight-one current. We classify the central extensions allowed by this residual algebra and find four independent cohomology classes in the $LL$, $LM$, $LS$, and $SS$ channels. We then construct the associated BRST complex, including the ghost pair for the radial Carroll-Weyl constraint. In the canonical highest-weight first-order representation, only the Virasoro-type central extension is realized: $(c_{LL},c_{LM},c_{LS},c_{SS})=(2D-54,0,0,0)$. Cancellation of the corresponding nontrivial BRST cocycle therefore gives $D=27$ in this representation. This differs structurally from the minimal flat Carroll-Weyl theory, where the dilation constraint $X\cdot P$ gives extra anomaly channels.
summary:
我们研究 $\mathrm{AdS}_D$ 庞加莱补丁中的 Carroll-Weyl 规范空串及其 BRST 量化。在庞加莱坐标 $X^A=(z,x^i)$ 中，径向共形 Killing 向量 $K=\partial_z$ 在合适的共角相关框架中变得相似。然后，对同势哈密顿约束进行场相关重新缩放，得到径向自适应基 $\mathcal{M}=\frac{1}{2}(P_z^2+P_iP^i)$、$\mathcal{L}=-P_AX'^A$ 和 $\mathcal{S}=P_z$，其中 $\mathcal{M}$ 沿 Carroll-Weyl 径向流不变。它们的模式形成一个由阿贝尔权重一电流扩展的 $\mathrm{BMS}_3$ 代数。我们对这个残差代数允许的中心扩展进行分类，并在 $LL$、$LM$、$LS$ 和 $SS$ 通道中找到四个独立的上同调类。然后，我们构建相关的 BRST 复合体，包括径向 Carroll-Weyl 约束的鬼对。在规范的最高权重一阶表示中，仅实现了 Virasoro 型中心扩展：$(c_{LL},c_{LM},c_{LS},c_{SS})=(2D-54,0,0,0)$。因此，取消相应的非平凡 BRST 循环给出该表示中的 $D=27$。

这在结构上不同于最小平面卡罗尔-韦尔理论，其中膨胀约束 $X\cdot P$ 给出了额外的异常通道。

title: Surface defects in $\mathcal{N}=4$ Super Yang-Mills: exact results and holographic bootstrap
abstract: We study two-point functions of chiral primary operators in $\mathcal{N}=4$ Super Yang-Mills in the presence of a half-BPS surface defect. Such a defect preserves only the diagonal combination of transverse rotations and of a global U(1) R-symmetry, so that the correlator depends on one additional cross-ratio and splits into sectors of definite angular charge. We solve the superconformal Ward identities and construct the bulk and defect superconformal blocks in all sectors, including the charged ones, which have no analogue for defects preserving transverse rotations. The solution contains a holomorphic sector, which we fix non-perturbatively by mapping it to a chiral algebra correlator. We extend this map to defects breaking transverse rotations, where it requires a redefinition of the modes of the two-dimensional current algebra, and use it to fix the charged sectors as well. We then use the defect dispersion relation to reconstruct the full correlator of the dimension-two chiral primary at leading order at large N and strong coupling. In the charged sectors long multiplets are absent and the answer is conjecturally exact in both N and the coupling; expanding it at weak coupling, we find perfect agreement with known results. From these correlators we extract infinitely many new pieces of defect CFT data. Finally, we reproduce the strong-coupling answer by an independent Witten diagram bootstrap on the rotation-invariant locus.
summary:
我们研究了存在半 BPS 表面缺陷的 $\mathcal{N}=4$ Super Yang-Mills 中手性主算子的两点函数。这种缺陷仅保留了横向旋转和全局 U(1) R 对称性的对角线组合，因此相关器依赖于一个额外的交叉比并分裂成具有确定角电荷的扇区。我们解决了超共形 Ward 恒等式，并在所有扇区（包括带电扇区）构造了块体和缺陷超共形块，这些块没有与保留横向旋转的缺陷类似的东西。该解包含一个全纯扇区，我们通过将其映射到手性代数相关器来非扰动地修复它。我们将此图扩展到破坏横向旋转的缺陷，其中需要重新定义二维电流代数的模式，并用它来修复带电扇区。然后，我们使用缺陷色散关系来重建大 N 和强耦合下前导阶的二维手性初级的全相关器。

在带电扇区中，不存在长多重态，并且推测答案在 N 和耦合中都是准确的；在弱耦合下扩展它，我们发现与已知结果完全一致。从这些相关器中，我们提取了无数新的缺陷 CFT 数据。最后，我们通过旋转不变轨迹上的独立维滕图自举来重现强耦合答案。

title: The hidden sunrise in the energy-energy correlator
abstract: The energy-energy correlator (EEC) is one of a handful of collider observables that can be computed analytically to high orders. As an energy-weighted cross-section, it exposes features of quantum field theory that scattering amplitudes do not, and it can be compared directly to data. As with scattering amplitudes, the analytic expressions require special functions beyond polylogarithms. In Henn et al., the EEC was computed to next-to-next-to-leading order (NNLO) for $\mathcal{N}=4$ super Yang-Mills (SYM) theory, and the result is expressed in terms of both harmonic polylogarithms (HPLs) and one two-fold integral, which contains elliptic curves. In this work, we report a complete result including the remaining elliptic sector, which is closely related to the sunrise Feynman integrals. We find the $j$-invariants of the EEC and the sunrise agree identically under a Möbius map, and thus the elliptic sector in the EEC lives on the $\Gamma_1(6)$ modular curve of the sunrise integral. We then express the answer in terms of iterated Eisenstein integrals, which can be evaluated to high precision quickly. The analytic form also allows a first study of the EEC Landau bootstrap, and the understanding of its function space in $\mathcal{N}=4$ SYM offers a concrete handle on the elliptic sector of the EEC in QCD. Many of the technical results in this paper were completed with AI under human supervision.
summary:
能量-能量相关器（EEC）是少数可以进行高阶分析计算的对撞机可观测量之一。作为能量加权截面，它揭示了散射振幅所没有的量子场论特征，并且可以直接与数据进行比较。与散射振幅一样，解析表达式需要多对数之外的特殊函数。在 Henn 等人中，针对 $\mathcal{N}=4$ super Yang-Mills (SYM) 理论，将 EEC 计算为次次次前导阶 (NNLO)，结果以调和多对数 (HPL) 和一个包含椭圆曲线的二次积分来表示。在这项工作中，我们报告了一个完整的结果，包括剩余的椭圆扇区，它与日出费曼积分密切相关。我们发现 EEC 和日出的 $j$ 不变量在莫比乌斯映射下完全相同，因此 EEC 中的椭圆扇形位于日出积分的 $\Gamma_1(6)$ 模曲线上。然后，我们用迭代爱森斯坦积分来表达答案，可以快速评估出高精度。

分析形式还允许对 EEC Landau bootstrap 进行首次研究，并理解其在 $\mathcal{N}=4$ SYM 中的函数空间，为 QCD 中 EEC 的椭圆扇区提供了具体的处理。本文的许多技术成果是在人类监督下通过人工智能完成的。

title: Polynomial and Eigenspace Factorisations for the One-loop Dilatation Operator at Finite $N$
abstract: We study gauge-invariant two-matrix polynomials of degree $L$, corresponding to the states in the $su(2)$ sector of $\mathcal{N}=4$ super Yang-Mills theory with gauge group $U(N)$ or $SU(N)$ at finite $N$. For the $U(N)$ theory, the state space has the structure of an algebra $\mathcal{A}_N(L)$, which is a direct sum of permutation centraliser algebras, i.e. sub-algebras of the group algebra $\mathbb{C}[S_L]$ of $S_L$. For $N \ge L$, $\mathcal{A}_N (L) = \mathcal{A} (L)$ is independent of $N$, and the one-loop dilatation operator acts on $\mathcal{A}(L)$ with $N$ as a parameter. For $N < L$, $\mathcal{A}_N (L)$ is a subspace of $\mathcal{A}(L)$ defined using a finite-$N$ cutoff on Young diagrams with $L$ boxes. We establish two results on the eigenspaces of the one-loop dilatation operator. Our first main result is that the characteristic polynomial of the one-loop dilatation operator on $\mathcal{A}_N(L)$ divides the characteristic polynomial from $\mathcal{A}(L)$, continued to $N < L$. Our second result is that each eigenstate of the one-loop dilatation operator in the $SU(N)$ theory generates an infinite tower of eigenstates in the $U(N)$ theory, through the multiplication of single-letter traces. These towers define an eigenspace factorisation of the $U(N)$ theory labelled by the number of such traces. Further, we conjecture that the space of $SU(N)$-invariant polynomials in two traceless matrices at finite $N$ is isomorphic to the intersection of $\mathcal{A}_N(L)$ with the subspace of $\mathbb{C}[S_L]$ spanned by derangements. This intersection conjecture is supported by dimension counting. Finally, we propose a one-loop dilatation operator on the intersection, thus providing a direct permutation framework for the $SU(N)$ spectral problem at finite $N$. The computed spectra based on the proposal agree with the prediction from the eigenspace factorisation in the $U(N)$ theory.
summary:
我们研究$L$次的规范不变二矩阵多项式，对应于$\mathcal{N}=4$超杨-米尔斯理论的$su(2)$扇区中的状态，规范组$U(N)$或$SU(N)$在有限$N$处。对于$U(N)$理论，状态空间具有代数$\mathcal{A}_N(L)$的结构，它是置换中心代数的直和，即$S_L$的群代数$\mathbb{C}[S_L]$的子代数。对于$N \ge L$，$\mathcal{A}_N (L) = \mathcal{A} (L)$与$N$无关，单循环膨胀算子以$N$为参数作用于$\mathcal{A}(L)$。对于 $N < L$，$\mathcal{A}_N (L)$ 是 $\mathcal{A}(L)$ 的子空间，使用带有 $L$ 框的 Young 图上的有限 $N$ 截止来定义。我们在单循环膨胀算子的特征空间上建立了两个结果。我们的第一个主要结果是 $\mathcal{A}_N(L)$ 上的单循环膨胀算子的特征多项式除以 $\mathcal{A}(L)$ 的特征多项式，继续到 $N < L$。

我们的第二个结果是 $SU(N)$ 理论中单循环膨胀算子的每个本征态通过单字母迹的乘法生成 $U(N)$ 理论中的无限本征态塔。这些塔定义了 $U(N)$ 理论的特征空间分解，并用此类迹线的数量标记。此外，我们推测有限 $N$ 处两个无迹矩阵中的 $SU(N)$ 不变多项式的空间同构于 $\mathcal{A}_N(L)$ 与 $\mathbb{C}[S_L]$ 的子空间的交集，该子空间由乱序跨越。这个相交猜想得到了维数计数的支持。最后，我们提出了一种关于交集的单循环膨胀算子，从而为有限$N$处的$SU(N)$谱问题提供了直接置换框架。基于该建议计算的光谱与 $U(N)$ 理论中特征空间分解的预测一致。

title: Fourier analysis of compact oscillons
abstract: We present a new derivation of the exact compact oscillon in the signum-Gordon model using Fourier methods. This approach decomposes the oscillon into an infinite, uniformly convergent series of discrete modes consisting of a fundamental frequency and its odd higher harmonics, in contrast to standard analytic potentials, where the corresponding infinite perturbative series fails to converge. Crucially, our oscillon evades the non-existence theorem for spatially localized, small-amplitude periodic states. We investigate the accuracy of truncating the Fourier series and find that the primary mode alone provides a remarkably accurate approximation of the exact solution, with agreement improving significantly when the first two non-vanishing harmonic modes are included. Furthermore, we generalize this framework to a swaying compact oscillon with a periodically moving boundary. We show that describing such an oscillon requires even-order modes, whose coupling with the odd source terms induces a dynamic modulation that generates the swaying motion, even though the spatial Fourier profiles themselves are time-independent.
summary: 我们使用傅里叶方法提出了 Signum-Gordon 模型中精确紧凑振荡的新推导。这种方法将振荡分解为由基频及其奇数高次谐波组成的无限、均匀收敛的离散模式系列，这与标准解析势相反，在标准解析势中，相应的无限微扰级数无法收敛。至关重要的是，我们的振荡避开了空间局域小振幅周期态的不存在定理。我们研究了截断傅里叶级数的准确性，发现仅主模式就提供了精确解的非常准确的近似值，当包含前两个非零谐波模式时，一致性显着提高。此外，我们将这个框架推广到具有周期性移动边界的摇摆紧凑振荡。我们表明，描述这种振荡需要偶数阶模式，其与奇数源项的耦合会引起动态调制，从而产生摇摆运动，即使空间傅里叶轮廓本身是与时间无关的。

title: Reconstruction of Black Hole Islands from Hawking Radiation via the Algebraic Petz Map
abstract: The island proposal guarantees a unitary Page curve for evaporating black holes, implying that operators deep behind the horizon must be fully reconstructable from asymptotic Hawking radiation. However, because the interior is causally disconnected and highly dynamical, standard entanglement wedge reconstruction methods, relying on global isometries or continuous modular flow, fail to provide this mapping. We resolve this by constructing a protocol for island reconstruction using the algebraic Petz map. By using modular theory, we reflect island operators into the accessible complement, transport them to the boundary, and map them into the radiation algebra. Furthermore, we demonstrate that this purely algebraic derivation naturally yields the structure of Papadodimas-Raju mirror operators. This framework provides a rigorous operational dictionary for the island formula, proving that information trapped inside a black hole can be decoded.
summary: 该岛的提议保证了蒸发黑洞的单一佩奇曲线，这意味着地平线深处的算子必须能够从渐近霍金辐射中完全重建。然而，由于内部是因果断开且高度动态的，依赖于全局等距或连续模块化流的标准纠缠楔重建方法无法提供这种映射。我们通过使用代数 Petz 图构建岛屿重建协议来解决这个问题。通过使用模块化理论，我们将岛屿算子反映到可达补体中，将它们传输到边界，并将它们映射到辐射代数中。此外，我们证明这种纯代数推导自然地产生 Papadodimas-Raju 镜像算子的结构。该框架为岛屿公式提供了严格的运算字典，证明了困在黑洞内的信息是可以解码的。

title: Beyond gauge-parameter dependence: Further evidence for asymptotic safety in Scalar-Tensor theories
abstract: Asymptotic Safety provides a promising framework for the quantization of Scalar-Tensor theories as non-perturbatively renormalizable quantum field theories. Over the past years, growing evidence has accumulated for the existence of non-trivial renormalization group fixed points in a variety of Scalar-Tensor models. In this work, we investigate the robustness of these fixed points under significant modifications of the computational setup. In particular, we employ a gauge condition that explicitly depends on the dynamical scalar field, going beyond a mere gauge-parameter deformation of the standard linear covariant gauges commonly used in the literature. Exploring different field parameterizations, we identify fixed points belonging to the Gaussian Matter class in four spacetime dimensions that are consistent with previous studies. The real part of the critical exponents associated with the scalar-field mass and the non-minimal scalar-curvature coupling turn out to have very small absolute value. We provide a comprehensive exploration of how the anomalous dimension of the scalar field and field parameterization impact those critical exponents showing that fixed-point candidates with two or four relevant directions emerge.
summary:
渐近安全性为将标量张量理论量化为非微扰可重整化量子场论提供了一个有前景的框架。在过去的几年里，越来越多的证据表明各种标量张量模型中存在非平凡的重整化群不动点。在这项工作中，我们研究了这些固定点在计算设置的重大修改下的鲁棒性。特别是，我们采用了明确依赖于动态标量场的规范条件，超出了文献中常用的标准线性协变规范的单纯规范参数变形。通过探索不同的场参数化，我们在四个时空维度上识别出属于高斯物质类的固定点，这与之前的研究一致。与标量场质量和非最小标量曲率耦合相关的临界指数的实部结果具有非常小的绝对值。

我们对标量场和场参数化的异常维度如何影响那些关键指数进行了全面的探索，表明出现了具有两个或四个相关方向的定点候选者。

title: The three- and four-loop equal-mass sunset integrals and local Calabi--Yau fourfolds and fivefolds
abstract: We determine the equal-mass two-dimensional three- and four-loop sunset Feynman integrals $I^{(3)}_\circleddash$ and $I^{(4)}_\circleddash$ at large Euclidean momentum in terms of the genus-zero Gromov--Witten theory of the local Calabi--Yau fourfold and fivefold $X_L=\operatorname{Tot}(K_{F_L})$, where $F_L\subset(\mathbb P^1)^{L+1}$, $L=3,4$, is a smooth hypersurface of multidegree $(1,\ldots,1)$. At two loops the sunset integral is governed by the prepotential of a local Calabi--Yau threefold. For $L\geq3$ the moduli spaces of unmarked stable maps have positive virtual dimension and there is no prepotential, therefore the Feynman integral is governed instead by the one-point potential $\mathcal F_{\gamma_L}$ with insertion $\gamma_L=H^{L-1}/(L-1)!$, by its gravitational descendants, and by $\zeta(3)$ boundary terms coming from the Gamma class. At both loop orders the coefficient of $R^{L-1}$ in the Frobenius expansion in the mirror coordinate $R$ is $-\theta_Q\mathcal F_{\gamma_L}$ with the Novikov variable $Q=\exp(R)$. At three loops the whole Feynman integral is an explicit expression in $\mathcal F_{\gamma_3}$ alone, because genus-zero recursion determines all descendant series from it; at four loops two diagonal series suffice, and the $\zeta(3)$ term is itself corrected by $\theta_Q\mathcal F_{\gamma_4}$. At three loops we also derive the analytic normalization independently, from the Picard--Fuchs equation and the polar part of a Mellin transform, prove integrality of the multiple-cover transforms for arbitrary integral insertions together with an explicit quantum-$K$ formula, and compute the exact period connection polynomials. Finally we give endpoint values along the Euclidean axis, bounds on the Taylor radii in the Novikov variable $Q$, a computer-assisted proof of the four-loop endpoint nonanalyticity, and a comparison of the normalizations at two, three and four loops.
summary:
我们根据局部卡拉比-丘四重和五重的亏格零 Gromov--Witten 理论确定大欧几里得动量下的等质量二维三环和四环日落费曼积分 $I^{(3)}_\circleddash$ 和 $I^{(4)}_\circleddash$，其中$F_L\subset(\mathbb P^1)^{L+1}$, $L=3,4$，是多次$(1,\ldots,1)$的光滑超曲面。在两个环路中，日落积分由当地卡拉比-丘三重的预势控制。对于$L\geq3$，未标记稳定映射的模空间具有正虚拟维数并且没有预势，因此费曼积分由单点势$\mathcal F_{\gamma_L}$ 和插入$\gamma_L=H^{L-1}/(L-1)!$、其引力后代和来自Gamma 类的$\zeta(3)$ 边界项控制。在两个循环阶数下，镜像坐标 $R$ 中 Frobenius 展开式中的 $R^{L-1}$ 系数为 $-\theta_Q\mathcal F_{\gamma_L}$，其中诺维科夫变量 $Q=\exp(R)$。

在三个循环中，整个费曼积分是 $\mathcal F_{\gamma_3}$ 中的显式表达式，因为属零递归从中确定了所有后代级数；在四个循环中，两个对角级数就足够了，并且 $\zeta(3)$ 项本身由 $\theta_Q\mathcal F_{\gamma_4}$ 校正。在三个循环中，我们还从 Picard--Fuchs 方程和 Mellin 变换的极坐标部分独立地导出解析归一化，证明任意积分插入的多重覆盖变换的完整性以及显式量子 $K$ 公式，并计算精确的周期连接多项式。最后，我们给出沿欧几里德轴的端点值、诺维科夫变量 $Q$ 中泰勒半径的界限、四循环端点非解析性的计算机辅助证明，以及两循环、三循环和四循环归一化的比较。

title: Massive de Sitter Correlators as Finite Mellin-Barnes Integrals
abstract: Using the Mellin-Barnes representation of de Sitter propagators, we reduce tree-level heavy-particle exchange to finite integrals that converge at physical kinematics on mass-independent contours, and one-loop diagrams to the same integrand times a flat-space momentum factor. We evaluate the triple-exchange bispectrum without analytic continuation and compute the complete one-loop triangle at general mass. These give cosmological collider predictions, the oscillatory signatures of heavy particles during inflation, for multiple exchanges and loops at arbitrary masses.
summary: 使用德西特传播器的 Mellin-Barnes 表示，我们将树级重粒子交换简化为有限积分，这些积分在与质量无关的轮廓上的物理运动学上收敛，并将单环图简化为相同的被积函数乘以平坦空间动量因子。我们在没有解析延拓的情况下评估三重交换双谱，并计算一般质量下的完整单环三角形。这些给出了宇宙学对撞机的预测，即膨胀期间重粒子的振荡特征，用于任意质量的多次交换和循环。

title: Quantum geometry at arbitrary genus - I: Anharmonic potentials
abstract: In quantum mechanics of genus-1 potentials, perturbation theory around the topologically trivial saddle and non-perturbative instanton saddle are constructively related via the P/NP relation. Whether such a relation persists for higher-genus potentials has remained an open problem. In this work, we resolve it using tools from complex algebraic geometry combined with exact WKB. The classical energy conservation relation $p^2 = 2(E-V(q))$ defines a genus-g Riemann surface $X$, whose periods are naturally organized by its Jacobian variety $J(X) = \mathbb{C}^{\text{g}}/\Lambda$ via the Abel-Jacobi map, and independently by the solution basis of the associated Picard-Fuchs equations. We show that the physically relevant, WKB-active cycles are generally related to the Picard-Fuchs basis by a linear transformation that lies in $\text{SL}(2\text{g},\mathbb{Z})$ but not in the symplectic group $\text{Sp}(2\text{g},\mathbb{Z})$ once $\text{g}\geq2$, in contrast to the genus-1 case, where the two groups coincide. This mismatch is the obstruction that has made an explicit higher-genus P/NP relation elusive. We show that it can be resolved by passing to a modified Riemann bilinear identity, built from a suitably transformed intersection matrix, which the WKB-active periods do satisfy exactly. The result is an all-orders quantum P/NP relation valid for potentials of arbitrary genus, which we derive explicitly for genus-2 (quintic and sextic) and genus-3 (septic and octic) anharmonic oscillators.
summary:
在 genus-1 势的量子力学中，围绕拓扑平凡鞍和非微扰瞬子鞍的微扰理论通过 P/NP 关系构建相关。对于更高属位的潜力，这种关系是否持续存在仍然是一个悬而未决的问题。在这项工作中，我们使用复杂代数几何工具与精确的 WKB 相结合来解决这个问题。经典能量守恒关系 $p^2 = 2(E-V(q))$ 定义了一个属 g 黎曼曲面 $X$，其周期通过阿贝尔-雅可比映射由其雅可比变体 $J(X) = \mathbb{C}^{\text{g}}/\Lambda$ 自然组织，并且独立地由相关皮卡德-福克斯方程的解基础组织。我们表明，物理相关的 WKB 活跃循环通常通过线性变换与 Picard-Fuchs 基相关，该线性变换位于 $\text{SL}(2\text{g},\mathbb{Z})$ 中，但不在辛群 $\text{Sp}(2\text{g},\mathbb{Z})$ 中一次 $\text{g}\geq2$ 中，与两个群重合的 genus-1 情况相反。这种不匹配是导致明确的高级属 P/NP 关系难以捉摸的障碍。

我们证明，它可以通过传递到一个修改的黎曼双线性恒等式来解决，该恒等式是根据适当变换的交集矩阵构建的，WKB 活跃周期确实满足该矩阵。结果是对任意 genus 势有效的全阶量子 P/NP 关系，我们为 genus-2（五次和六次）和 genus-3（败数和八次）非简振子明确推导了该关系。

title: Fermionic Spectral Functions in a Two-Current Gubser-Rocha Model with Axion Momentum Relaxation
abstract: We investigate fermionic spectral functions in a two-current Gubser-Rocha background with linear-axion momentum relaxation. Serving as a comparison channel, the dipole coupling $p_1$ is found to produce a soft asymmetric reconstruction without opening a clean hard Mott gap. Our main analysis then focuses on two axion-dependent non-minimal couplings modulated by current mixing. The $p_2$ tensor channel suppresses the zero-energy Fermi peak and shifts the dominant spectral weight to finite frequencies, resulting in a flat-bottom reconstruction. In contrast, the $p_3$ vector channel creates a strong spectral asymmetry in momentum space, generating open, Fermi-arc-like segments. Varying the momentum-relaxation strength $\beta/\mu$ and the doping parameter $\chi$ reveals a channel-dependent response to the two-current background. Increasing $\beta/\mu$ generally broadens the $p_2$ response, whereas the one-sided $p_3$ feature varies non-monotonically under changes of the background parameters. These results clarify how current mixing, axion-induced momentum relaxation, and non-minimal fermion couplings jointly reshape holographic fermionic excitations. These results clarify how current mixing, axion-induced momentum relaxation, and non-minimal fermion couplings jointly reshape holographic fermionic excitations.
summary:
我们研究了具有线性轴子动量弛豫的双电流 Gubser-Rocha 背景中的费米子谱函数。作为比较通道，偶极子耦合 $p_1$ 被发现可以产生软不对称重建，而无需打开干净的硬莫特间隙。然后，我们的主要分析集中于由电流混合调制的两个轴子相关的非最小耦合。 $p_2$ 张量通道抑制零能量费米峰并将主要谱权重转移到有限频率，从而产生平底重建。相比之下，$p_3$矢量通道在动量空间中产生强烈的光谱不对称性，生成开放的、费米弧状的段。改变动量弛豫强度 $\beta/\mu$ 和掺杂参数 $\chi$ 揭示了对两电流背景的通道相关响应。增加 $\beta/\mu$ 通常会拓宽 $p_2$ 响应，而单侧 $p_3$ 特征在背景参数的变化下非单调变化。这些结果阐明了电流混合、轴子引起的动量弛豫和非最小费米子耦合如何共同重塑全息费米子激发。

这些结果阐明了电流混合、轴子引起的动量弛豫和非最小费米子耦合如何共同重塑全息费米子激发。

title: Quantum Gravity in Asymptotically Flat Spacetimes from Unstable D-Branes
abstract: We present a non-perturbative formulation of quantum gravity in asymptotically flat spacetimes using Witten's cubic open string field theory (OSFT) on unstable D-branes. Given that the massless spin-2 sector of the closed string spectrum inherently encodes the degrees of freedom of quantum gravity, we establish this connection by mapping on-shell closed string excitations directly to gauge-invariant operators in OSFT, realizing a concrete flat-space analogue of the AdS/CFT correspondence. By evaluating the OSFT correlation functions of these operators perturbatively around the tachyon vacuum, we systematically reproduce the all-orders genus expansion of the closed string S-matrix for the associated states. This demonstrates that closed string theory-and thus quantum gravity-emerges dynamically from the open string tachyon vacuum, establishing Witten's OSFT as a fully calculable, non-perturbative framework for flat-space quantum gravity.
summary: 我们使用 Witten 的立方开弦场理论 (OSFT) 在不稳定的 D 膜上提出了渐近平坦时空中量子引力的非微扰公式。鉴于闭弦谱的无质量自旋 2 扇区本质上编码了量子引力的自由度，我们通过将壳上闭弦激励直接映射到 OSFT 中的规范不变算子来建立这种联系，实现了 AdS/CFT 对应关系的具体平坦空间模拟。通过在快子真空周围微扰地评估这些算子的 OSFT 相关函数，我们系统地再现了相关状态的闭弦 S 矩阵的全阶属展开。这表明闭弦理论以及量子引力是从开弦快子真空中动态出现的，将威滕的 OSFT 确立为平坦空间量子引力的完全可计算、非微扰框架。

title: No Particle Production and Integrability in AdS$_2$
abstract: We propose an analogue of the no particle production condition in two-dimensional anti-de Sitter space, and demonstrate how this criterion uniquely reconstructs the curved-space Liouville and Toda theories via general-multiplicity holographic correlators.
summary: 我们提出了二维反德西特空间中无粒子产生条件的类比，并证明了该准则如何通过广义多重性全息相关器独特地重建弯曲空间刘维尔和托达理论。

title: Dielectric constant of holographic insulator from quantum geometry
abstract: We study dielectric properties of holographic insulators from the quantum geometry of the ground state. We realize the insulating state by the pseudoscalar interaction of holographic fermions and calculate the fermionic Green function to extract the effective hamiltonian. We then derive the quantum metric and Berry curvature to compute the transports and finally get the dielectric constant from the imaginary part of conductivity.
summary: 我们从基态的量子几何结构研究全息绝缘体的介电特性。我们通过全息费米子的赝标量相互作用实现绝缘态，并计算费米子格林函数以提取有效哈密顿量。然后我们推导量子度量和贝里曲率来计算传输，最后从电导率的虚部得到介电常数。

title: Extremal black hole mimickers: geometry, stability, and long-delay signal trains
abstract: We present a spacetime that serves as a horizonless mimicker of extremal black holes. Unlike previously studied mimickers of black holes with non-degenerate horizons, whose geometries are of the wormhole type and consist of two asymptotically flat regions connected by a very long throat, the mimicker of an extremal black hole possesses a single asymptotically flat region at one end and an infinitely long throat at the other. In the throat region, the spacetime approaches the direct-product geometry $M_{1,1} \times S^2$, where $M_{1,1}$ is two-dimensional Minkowski spacetime and $S^2$ is the two-sphere. We investigate scalar-field dynamics and the fate of the Aretakis instability. Although Aretakis-like modes arise in a local analysis of the throat, they do not lead to a physical instability of the mimicker. A scalar perturbation initially localized in the throat gives rise, at late times, to a sequence of signals with a characteristic separation $t_{\rm delay}\sim 1/\lambda$, where $\lambda\ll 1$ is a deformation parameter. This timescale is parametrically larger than the echo time $t_{\rm echo}\sim \ln(1/\lambda)$ characteristic of non-extremal black-hole mimickers. We refer to this sequence as a {\it long-delay signal train}. Geometrically, the periodicity of the long-delay signals is associated with periodic geodesics on $S^2$. We then extend the construction to extremal Kerr. In this case, the throat region approaches a generalized product geometry involving $M_{1,1}$ and a two-dimensional surface $\Sigma_2$. The corresponding signals are expected to form a quasi-periodic signal train, reflecting the quasi-periodic geodesic motion on $\Sigma_2$. We also comment on the generalization to wormhole mimickers of non-extremal black holes and on the implications of these results for unitarity in the context of the AdS/CFT correspondence.
summary:
我们提出了一个时空，作为极值黑洞的无地平线模仿者。与之前研究的具有非简并视界的黑洞拟态体不同，其几何形状为虫洞类型，由两个由很长的喉部连接的渐近平坦区域组成，极值黑洞的拟态体在一端具有单个渐近平坦区域，在另一端具有无限长的喉部。在喉部区域，时空接近直积几何$M_{1,1} \times S^2$，其中$M_{1,1}$是二维Minkowski时空，$S^2$是二球体。我们研究标量场动力学和阿雷塔基斯不稳定性的命运。尽管类似阿雷塔基斯的模式出现在喉咙的局部分析中，但它们不会导致模仿者的物理不稳定。最初位于喉部的标量扰动在后期会产生一系列具有特征分离 $t_{\rm delay}\sim 1/\lambda$ 的信号，其中 $\lambda\ll 1$ 是变形参数。该时间尺度在参数上大于非极值黑洞拟态器的回波时间 $t_{\rm echo}\sim \ln(1/\lambda)$ 特征。

我们将此序列称为{\it长延迟信号序列}。从几何角度来看，长延迟信号的周期性与 $S^2$ 上的周期性测地线相关。然后我们将构造扩展到极值克尔。在这种情况下，喉部区域接近涉及 $M_{1,1}$ 和二维表面 $\Sigma_2$ 的广义产品几何形状。相应的信号预计会形成准周期信号串，反映$\Sigma_2$上的准周期测地线运动。我们还评论了对非极值黑洞的虫洞模仿者的推广，以及这些结果对 AdS/CFT 对应关系中统一性的影响。

title: Entanglement entropy of black holes from the first law of thermodynamics
abstract: We compute the entanglement entropy of quantum matter in spacetimes with a Killing horizon entirely on-shell, by integrating the first law of thermodynamics along a one-parameter family of equilibrium backgrounds labelled by the Hawking temperature. This yields a closed expression in terms of the renormalized stress-energy tensor and the Killing vector, finite by construction, with no replicas and no conical singularities. Its covariant form agrees with the matter terms of the Bardeen--Carter--Hawking mass variation formula. We show in details that for static patch of de Sitter space and for the non-rotating BTZ black hole it reproduces the conical entropy exactly, contact term $Q$ included.
summary: 我们通过沿着霍金温度标记的单参数平衡背景族整合热力学第一定律，计算时空中量子物质的纠缠熵，其杀伤视界完全在壳上。这产生了重正化应力能量张量和 Killing 向量的闭合表达式，通过构造有限，没有复制品，也没有圆锥奇点。其协变形式与巴丁-卡特-霍金质量变分公式的物质项一致。我们详细展示了对于德西特空间的静态补丁和非旋转 BTZ 黑洞，它精确地再现了圆锥熵，包括接触项 $Q$。

title: Einstein-Cartan and Palatini-Cartan Gravity from Graded Poisson Geometry
abstract: Using notions from graded Poisson geometry, we develop a framework that allows for concise formulations of field theories such as Einstein-Cartan and Palatini-Cartan gravity. We show that Einstein-Cartan gravity is equivalent to a variant of Palatini-Cartan gravity in which the vielbein fields are constrained to satisfy appropriate symmetry relations, which we refer to as constrained vielbein gravity. To that end, we relate these theories via a diffeomorphism of graded manifolds. We then show how to obtain the full Palatini-Cartan theory by removing the symmetry constraint. Finally, we show how our graded geometric framework allows for a direct incorporation of the minimal BV extension of the graded constrained vielbein and Palatini-Cartan theories.
summary: 使用分级泊松几何的概念，我们开发了一个框架，可以对爱因斯坦-嘉当引力和帕拉蒂尼-嘉当引力等场论进行简洁的表述。我们证明爱因斯坦-嘉当引力等价于帕拉蒂尼-嘉当引力的一种变体，其中维尔宾场被约束以满足适当的对称关系，我们将其称为约束维尔宾引力。为此，我们通过分级流形的微分同胚将这些理论联系起来。然后，我们展示如何通过消除对称约束来获得完整的 Palatini-Cartan 理论。最后，我们展示了我们的分级几何框架如何允许直接纳入分级约束 vielbein 和 Palatini-Cartan 理论的最小 BV 扩展。

title: Multipartite Entanglement Geometry in AdS/BCFT
abstract: Multipartite entanglement measures probe how quantum correlations are organized beyond what can be inferred from pairwise entropies. We study how this structure is reshaped by a physical boundary in a holographic BCFT. The end-of-the-world brane opens new relative-homology channels for multipartite entanglement, allowing connected bulk webs to reorganize and factorize at scales that need not coincide with any ordinary Ryu--Takayanagi transition. In static AdS$_3$/BCFT$_2$, this produces a characteristic hierarchy of multipartite phases and a nontrivial dependence of genuine multi-entropy on the boundary. In the thermofield-double state, genuinely connected webs can instead be supported through the Einstein--Rosen bridge, leading to growth, reconnection and saturation scales distinct from the usual Hartman--Maldacena transitions. These results show that multipartite entanglement is sensitive not only to extremal-surface areas but also to how bulk entanglement structures are allowed to join, split and terminate in the presence of a boundary.
summary: 多部分纠缠测量探究了量子相关性是如何组织的，超出了从成对熵推断的范围。我们研究了全息 BCFT 中的物理边界如何重塑该结构。世界末日膜为多部分纠缠开辟了新的相对同源通道，允许连接的大块网络以不需要与任何普通的 Ryu-Takayanagi 转变相一致的规模进行重组和分解。在静态 AdS$_3$/BCFT$_2$ 中，这会产生多部分相的特征层次结构以及真正的多熵对边界的非平凡依赖性。在热场双态下，真正连接的网络可以通过爱因斯坦-罗森桥得到支持，从而导致与通常的哈特曼-马尔达塞纳转变不同的生长、重新连接和饱和尺度。这些结果表明，多部分纠缠不仅对极值表面区域敏感，而且对在边界存在的情况下如何允许块状纠缠结构连接、分裂和终止敏感。

title: Mass quench in interacting finite-size quantum field system
abstract: In this work, we theoretically investigate the non-equilibrium evolution of the correlation functions of a quantum scalar field following a mass quantum quench in a finite-size system. The self-consistent equation for the Keldysh (statistical) correlation function is solved numerically in the one-loop approximation. A specific spatio-temporal effect is observed: at a point in time approximately equal to half the system size, the effective mass experiences a strong disturbance. It is shown that this effect is driven by the interference of counter-propagating wave fronts of fluctuations that propagate within the light cone and is induced by periodic boundary conditions.
summary: 在这项工作中，我们从理论上研究了有限尺寸系统中大规模量子淬灭后量子标量场相关函数的非平衡演化。 Keldysh（统计）相关函数的自洽方程通过单循环近似进行数值求解。观察到特定的时空效应：在大约等于系统大小一半的时间点，有效质量经历强烈的扰动。结果表明，这种效应是由在光锥内传播的波动的反向传播波前的干涉驱动的，并且是由周期性边界条件引起的。

title: Probability measures for de Sitter JT gravity
abstract: Jackiw-Teitelboim (JT) gravity with positive cosmological constant is a toy model to study the emergence of expanding de Sitter universes from a quantum state. Its density matrix is a superposition of double-trumpet amplitudes which are solutions of a Wheeler-DeWitt equation. We compare predictions of such mixed states for classical expanding universes with the corresponding predictions of no-boundary wavefunctions. Double-trumpet amplitudes consistent with holography, whose semiclassical limit matches the result from Schwarzian boundary fluctuations, lead to a flat probability distribution for the size of the universe, consistent with models of inflation. This is in contrast to the suppression of large universes predicted by no-boundary wave functions.
summary: 具有正宇宙学常数的 Jackiw-Teitelboim (JT) 引力是一个玩具模型，用于研究从量子态开始膨胀的德西特宇宙的出现。它的密度矩阵是双喇叭振幅的叠加，是惠勒-德威特方程的解。我们将经典膨胀宇宙的这种混合态的预测与无边界波函数的相应预测进行比较。与全息术一致的双喇叭振幅，其半经典极限与施瓦茨边界涨落的结果相匹配，导致宇宙大小的平坦概率分布，与暴胀模型一致。这与无边界波函数预测的大宇宙的抑制形成鲜明对比。

title: Asymptotic Safety in Gauge Theories beyond Four Dimensions: Perturbative Tests and Fixed-Point Mergers
abstract: Non-Abelian gauge theories above four dimensions may admit an interacting ultraviolet fixed point through the competition between canonical scaling and gauge-field antiscreening. Using the four-loop $\overline{\mathrm{MS}}$ beta function continued to $D=4+2\epsilon$, we determine the largest dimension $D_{\mathrm{pt}}=4+2\epsilon_{\mathrm{pt}}$ below which successive loop corrections to the fixed point remain hierarchically ordered under a specified ratio criterion, and map $D_{\mathrm{pt}}$ over color and flavor numbers for fermions in the fundamental representation of $SU(N)$. At $D=5$, we construct rational anomalous dimensions with a fixed, pole-regularized denominator inspired by the functional renormalization group (fRG). Matching to the $\overline{\mathrm{MS}}$ series through one, two, and three loops produces progressively smaller shifts in the critical flavor number and coupling at the ultraviolet--infrared merger (the point where the infrared and ultraviolet fixed points coincide), yielding $N_f^{\mathrm{cr}}\simeq 2.09 \, N$ at large $N$ in the three-loop construction. This low-order stabilization, together with qualitative evidence from fRG flows including higher gauge operators, suggests a potential merger scenario that bounds the candidate asymptotically safe region in flavor number. The resulting color--flavor map provides guidance for five-dimensional model building by displaying both the baseline perturbative-control boundary and the candidate three-loop merger boundary. Four-loop matching, however, retains an interacting ultraviolet fixed point beyond the three-loop merger boundary, with no merger found for integer $2\le N\le15$ and $0\le N_f/N\le11/2$. The sensitivity of the fixed-point structure to higher-order terms leaves both scenarios open, highlighting fixed-point annihilation as a potential constraint on five-dimensional asymptotic safety.
summary:
四维以上的非阿贝尔规范理论可以通过规范标度和规范场反屏蔽之间的竞争来承认相互作用的紫外线不动点。使用四循环 $\overline{\mathrm{MS}}$ beta 函数继续到 $D=4+2\epsilon$，我们确定最大维度 $D_{\mathrm{pt}}=4+2\epsilon_{\mathrm{pt}}$ 在指定比率标准下，对固定点的连续循环校正保持分层排序，并将 $D_{\mathrm{pt}}$ 映射到费米子的颜色和风味数$SU(N)$ 的基本表示。在 $D=5$ 时，我们受函数重正化群 (fRG) 的启发，用固定的极点正则化分母构造有理反常维度。通过一个、两个和三个循环与$\overline{\mathrm{MS}}$系列相匹配，会在紫外-红外合并处（红外和紫外固定点重合的点）处产生临界风味数和耦合的逐渐较小的变化，从而在三循环结构中产生$N_f^{\mathrm{cr}}\simeq 2.09 \，N$在大$N$处。

这种低阶稳定，加上来自 fRG 流（包括更高规格算子）的定性证据，表明了一种潜在的合并场景，该场景限制了候选渐近安全区域的风味数。由此产生的颜色-风味图通过显示基线扰动控制边界和候选三环合并边界为五维模型构建提供指导。然而，四环匹配保留了超出三环合并边界的相互作用的紫外固定点，对于整数 $2\le N\le15$ 和 $0\le N_f/N\le11/2$ 没有发现合并。定点结构对高阶项的敏感性使这两种情况都开放，突出了定点湮灭作为五维渐近安全性的潜在约束。

title: Horizon symmetries of exact hydrodynamic actions
abstract: We demonstrate how horizon symmetries of AdS black holes are realised in the hydrodynamic actions for the dynamics of the dual stress tensor. A recent approach for obtaining such actions involves a choice of horizon boundary conditions, and we show that diffeomorphisms that preserve these give rise to symmetries of the corresponding hydrodynamic action. We obtain explicit hydrodynamic actions for small amplitude perturbations of black holes in JT and AdS$_3$ gravity using this approach and demonstrate explicitly the existence of these symmetries. For a natural choice of boundary conditions, the resulting actions manifestly realise gauge symmetries previously proposed for effective theories of maximal chaos.
summary: 我们展示了 AdS 黑洞的视界对称性是如何在双应力张量动力学的流体动力学作用中实现的。最近获得此类作用的方法涉及选择层位边界条件，并且我们表明，保留这些条件的微分同胚会产生相应的流体动力作用的对称性。我们使用这种方法获得了 JT 和 AdS$_3$ 引力中黑洞小幅度扰动的明确流体动力学作用，并明确证明了这些对称性的存在。对于边界条件的自然选择，所产生的作用显然实现了先前为有效最大混沌理论提出的规范对称性。

title: Stringy resolution of bouncing singularities
abstract: We study the near-horizon geometry of near-extremal NS5 branes, which admits an exact worldsheet description in terms of the $SL(2,\mathbb{R})_k/U(1)$ coset. In the supergravity limit, the analytically continued time-domain reflection amplitude exhibits a singularity associated with a null geodesic bouncing off the black-hole singularity, analogous to the bouncing singularities of boundary correlators in asymptotically AdS spacetimes. We show that finite-string-length effects render this amplitude an entire function of complex time, completely resolving the bouncing singularity. This resolution is nonperturbative in the inverse coset level: the singularity persists at every finite order in the expansion.
summary: 我们研究近极值 NS5 膜的近地平线几何，它允许根据 $SL(2,\mathbb{R})_k/U(1)$ 陪集进行精确的世界表描述。在超重力极限下，分析上连续的时域反射幅度表现出与从黑洞奇点反弹的零测地线相关的奇点，类似于渐近 AdS 时空中边界相关器的反弹奇点。我们证明，有限弦长度效应使该振幅成为复数时间的完整函数，完全解决了弹跳奇点。该分辨率在逆陪集级别上是非微扰的：奇点在展开中的每个有限阶上都持续存在。

title: Cornering the Heterotic String
abstract: We study tree-level completions of four-dimensional $\mathcal N=4$ Yang--Mills theory coupled to $\mathcal N=4$ supergravity. Six-point factorization and supersymmetry Ward identities, supplemented by a peculiar-parity restriction on scalar contact terms, impose nonlinear relations between the single- and double-trace Wilson coefficients, $a_{k,q}$ and $b_{k,q}$, of the four-gluon amplitude. The simplest relation, $\kappa^2a_{0,0}=0$, excludes the single-trace $F^4$ interaction at nonzero gravitational coupling, despite its compatibility with four-point supersymmetry. On this gravitational branch, five double-trace parameters determine all coefficients through $a_{7,q}$ and $b_{8,q}$, which are reproduced by a common exponential generating form. Both the heterotic string and a family of infinite-spin-tower (IST) amplitudes realize this structure. Combining these relations with dispersion relations and partial-wave positivity in $SO(N)$ color channels yields a narrow numerical band closely bounded by the heterotic and simplest IST amplitudes. A spin-dependent mass gap excludes the IST spectrum and further localizes the region near the heterotic trajectory. An analytic unitarity analysis of the simplest IST gives $N\leq48$ and $g^2/(\kappa^2 m^2)\leq4$, matching the upper limits of the heterotic amplitude, where $m$ is the mass of the first massive level. Along the heterotic trajectory, the numerical bounds also sharply constrain the gauge-to-gravity coupling ratio at $N=48$.
summary:
我们研究四维 $\mathcal N=4$ Yang--Mills 理论与 $\mathcal N=4$ 超引力的树级完成。六点分解和超对称 Ward 恒等式，辅以标量接触项的奇宇称限制，在四胶子振幅的单迹和双迹 Wilson 系数 $a_{k,q}$ 和 $b_{k,q}$ 之间施加非线性关系。最简单的关系 $\kappa^2a_{0,0}=0$ 排除了非零引力耦合下的单迹 $F^4$ 相互作用，尽管它与四点超对称性兼容。在这个引力分支上，五个双迹参数通过 $a_{7,q}$ 和 $b_{8,q}$ 确定所有系数，并通过常见的指数生成形式再现。杂优势弦和一系列无限自旋塔（IST）振幅都实现了这种结构。将这些关系与 $SO(N)$ 颜色通道中的色散关系和部分波正性相结合，产生一个狭窄的数值带，该数值带与杂种和最简单的 IST 振幅紧密相连。自旋相关的质量间隙排除了 IST 谱，并进一步定位了杂种轨迹附近的区域。

最简单 IST 的解析幺正性分析给出 $N\leq48$ 和 $g^2/(\kappa^2 m^2)\leq4$，匹配杂种优势幅度的上限，其中 $m$ 是第一个质量水平的质量。沿着异质轨迹，数值界限也将规范与重力耦合比严格限制在 $N=48$。

title: Differential $T_2$-Duality and Spans of Principal 3-Bundles with Connections
abstract: We present a generalization of T-duality, called $T_2$-duality, that captures certain aspects of U-duality in M-theory. In particular, it features backgrounds that contain a 2-gerbe over a principal torus bundle, structures familiar from eleven-dimensional supergravity backgrounds. In special cases, it also incorporates S-duality in a precise sense. Our main result is a theorem characterizing $T_2$-dual pairs through spans of categorified principal bundles with connections, giving explicit rules for constructing a $T_2$-dual for a given background. A number of explicit examples illustrate how the various characteristic classes are mapped between the left and right backgrounds. For two-dimensional torus fibers, we also relate our construction to the combination of dimensional reduction and T-duality that links eleven-dimensional supergravity to type IIB supergravity. Finally, we discuss how $T_2$-duality arises from a Buscher-like span of 3d sigma models.
summary: 我们提出了 T 对偶性的概括，称为 $T_2$-对偶性，它捕获了 M 理论中 U 对偶性的某些方面。特别是，它的背景在主环面束上包含 2-gerbe，这是十一维超重力背景中常见的结构。在特殊情况下，它还包含了精确意义上的S对偶性。我们的主要结果是通过具有连接的分类主丛的跨度来表征 $T_2$-对偶的定理，给出了为给定背景构建 $T_2$-对偶的明确规则。许多明确的示例说明了各种特征类别如何在左背景和右背景之间映射。对于二维环面纤维，我们还将我们的构造与降维和 T 对偶性的组合联系起来，将十一维超重力与 IIB 型超重力联系起来。最后，我们讨论 $T_2$-对偶性如何从 3d sigma 模型的 Buscher 式跨度中产生。

title: Platonic self-dual solitons in a (1+1)-dimensional $\mathbb{CP}^1$ model
abstract: We construct a family of self-dual $(1+1)$-dimensional $\mathbb{CP}^1$ sigma models whose potentials $V$ are determined from pre-potentials $U$ by Platonic geometry. Using the round metric on $\mathbb{S}^2\simeq\mathbb{CP}^1$ and the generalized self-duality formalism, we build symmetry-invariant pre-potentials $U$ from the unit vertices of each Platonic solid intersecting the unit circumsphere. The regular-lattice sites associated with vertex, face-center, and edge-midpoint directions are critical points of $U$ and degenerate vacua of the scalar potential $V$. Dual solids share the same regular lattice but generate different pre-potentials, charges, potentials, and metric-gradient flows. Numerical integration reveals distinct self-dual trajectories and energy-density profiles, including multi-peak structures for paths passing near saddle points, while solutions with the same endpoint difference $\Delta U$ have the same total energy. The positive maxima of $V$ are also organized into symmetry orbits. This construction provides a geometric prescription for controlling the vacuum structure and self-dual sectors of $\mathbb{CP}^1$ models with a potential.
summary: 我们构建了一系列自对偶 $(1+1)$ 维 $\mathbb{CP}^1$ sigma 模型，其势 $V$ 由柏拉图几何的预势 $U$ 确定。使用 $\mathbb{S}^2\simeq\mathbb{CP}^1$ 上的圆度量和广义自对偶形式主义，我们从与单位外接球相交的每个柏拉图固体的单位顶点构建对称不变预势 $U$。与顶点、面心和边中点方向相关的规则晶格位点是 $U$ 的临界点和标量势 $V$ 的简并真空。双固体共享相同的规则晶格，但产生不同的预电势、电荷、电势和度量梯度流。数值积分揭示了不同的自对偶轨迹和能量密度分布，包括通过鞍点附近的路径的多峰结构，而具有相同端点差 $\Delta U$ 的解具有相同的总能量。 $V$ 的正最大值也被组织成对称轨道。这种结构为控制具有潜力的 $\mathbb{CP}^1$ 模型的真空结构和自对偶扇区提供了几何处方。

title: Energy-energy correlators in the large-charge limit of $\mathcal{N}=4$ super Yang-Mills theory
abstract: We study the energy-energy correlator (EEC) in heavy states of four-dimensional $\mathcal N=4$ super Yang--Mills theory in the large-charge 't Hooft limit, in which the dimension $\Delta$ of the heavy operator (or, equivalently, its $R$-charge) is taken to infinity with the effective coupling $\lambda_Q \propto g_{\mathrm{YM}}^2\Delta$ held fixed. The relevant heavy-heavy-light-light four-point correlators are known to all orders in $\lambda_Q$ in this limit. For certain classes of operators, the perturbative series can be resummed to obtain exact finite-coupling expressions. We use these results to determine the corresponding EEC, whose dynamical part can be extracted from a double discontinuity of the four-point correlator. We determine the EEC at finite effective coupling and study its physical behavior as a function of $\lambda_Q$ and the angular separation between the detectors, both at generic angles and in the collinear and back-to-back limits.
summary: 我们研究了大电荷't Hooft极限下四维$\mathcal N=4$超杨-米尔斯理论的重态下的能量-能量相关器(EEC)，其中重算子的维度$\Delta$（或者等效地，它的$R$-电荷）被取为无穷大，有效耦合$\lambda_Q \propto g_{\mathrm{YM}}^2\Delta$保持固定。相关的重-重-轻-轻四点相关器对于这个极限中$\lambda_Q$中的所有阶都是已知的。对于某些类别的算子，可以恢复微扰级数以获得精确的有限耦合表达式。我们使用这些结果来确定相应的 EEC，其动态部分可以从四点相关器的双不连续性中提取。我们确定有限有效耦合下的 EEC，并研究其物理行为作为 $\lambda_Q$ 和探测器之间角度间隔的函数，无论是在通用角度还是在共线和背靠背限制下。

title: A real superpotential for M-theory on eight-manifolds
abstract: We study warped compactifications of eleven-dimensional supergravity on eight-manifolds to Minkowski or AdS vacua preserving $N=1$ supersymmetry in three dimensions. For backgrounds characterised by a local G$_2$ structure, we derive an off-shell real superpotential functional in terms of the internal geometry and fluxes without performing a finite Kaluza-Klein truncation. We obtain this expression in two independent ways: from the dimensional reduction of the gravitino variation and from the reduction of the eleven-dimensional gravitino action. We show that the critical-point equations, together with the vacuum value of the superpotential, are equivalent to the full set of supersymmetry conditions implied by the eleven-dimensional Killing spinor equations. When the local G$_2$ structure enhances to a global Spin(7) structure, our result reduces to the known superpotential for M-theory on Spin(7) manifolds.
summary: 我们研究八流形上十一维超引力的扭曲致密化到 Minkowski 或 AdS 真空，在三个维度上保持 $N=1$ 超对称性。对于以局部 G$_2$ 结构为特征的背景，我们根据内部几何形状和通量推导出离壳实超势泛函，而无需执行有限 Kaluza-Klein 截断。我们通过两种独立的方式获得这个表达式：从引力变分的维数约简和从十一维引力作用的约简。我们证明了临界点方程以及超势的真空值等价于十一维 Killing 旋量方程所隐含的全套超对称条件。当局部 G$_2$ 结构增强为全局 Spin(7) 结构时，我们的结果简化为 Spin(7) 流形上 M 理论的已知超势。

title: Finite- and long-range spin-wave free-energy asymptotics for the two-dimensional quantum Heisenberg ferromagnet
abstract: For the two-dimensional quantum Heisenberg ferromagnet with asymptotically radial power-law exchange, we prove the leading low-temperature free energy at every fixed spin, uniformly on the weak-field scale. We obtain fractional and logarithmically corrected laws associated with the dispersions predicted in [16, 17]. Quantum Monte Carlo simulations support the associated anomalous magnon dispersions for spin one-half [20]. For kernels with finite second moment, we also extend the nearest-neighbour theorem [14], generalizing Takahashi's quadratic law [21] and its weak-field dependence [11].
summary: 对于具有渐近径向幂律交换的二维量子海森堡铁磁体，我们证明了在弱场尺度上均匀自旋的领先低温自由能。我们获得了与[16, 17]中预测的色散相关的分数和对数校正定律。量子蒙特卡罗模拟支持自旋二分之一相关的反常磁振子色散[20]。对于具有有限二阶矩的核，我们还扩展了最近邻定理[14]，推广了高桥二次定律[21]及其弱场依赖性[11]。

title: Uniformity theory of weighted composites
abstract: By including spatially varying volume fractions of the constituents, composites are obtained that are akin to functionally graded media. An extension of the mathematical apparatus of double groupoids is proposed to incorporate these materials with the aim of eventually classifying defects of misalignment and their time evolution.
summary: 通过包含空间变化的成分体积分数，可以获得类似于功能梯度介质的复合材料。提出了双群群数学装置的扩展，以合并这些材料，目的是最终对未对准缺陷及其时间演化进行分类。

title: Extended States on the Bethe Lattice Revisited
abstract: We give a short proof of the classical weak-disorder result that the Anderson model on the Bethe lattice has purely absolutely continuous spectrum on compact intervals in the interior of the free spectrum. This note continues [6], where we gave a minimal proof of the existence of a nontrivial absolutely continuous component using the cyclicity criterion of [8]. There, Hellinger overlap yields the required non-cyclicity. Here, a stability argument for the forward Green function, followed by the zero--one law for the tree recursion, yields positivity of its boundary imaginary part. This positivity already gives absolutely continuous spectrum throughout the interval; the structural result of [7] excludes singular spectrum and yields purity. We also observe that the same structural argument shortens the final passage from boundary positivity to purity in the recent OpenAI preprint on the weak-disorder Anderson model on $\zz^d$, $d\geq3$ [10].
summary: 我们给出了经典弱无序结果的简短证明，即贝特晶格上的安德森模型在自由谱内部的紧间隔上具有纯绝对连续谱。本注释继续[6]，其中我们使用[8]的循环准则给出了非平凡绝对连续分量存在的最小证明。在那里，海灵格重叠产生了所需的非循环性。这里，前向格林函数的稳定性论证，以及树递归的零一定律，产生了其边界虚部的正值。这种积极性已经在整个区间内给出了绝对连续的频谱； [7]的结构结果排除了奇异光谱并产生纯度。我们还观察到，在最近关于 $\zz^d$、$d\geq3$ 的弱无序安德森模型的 OpenAI 预印本中，相同的结构论证缩短了从边界积极性到纯粹性的最终通道[10]。

title: Wrinkling of a bilayered cylinder under tension
abstract: We study near-surface tension instabilities in bilayered cylinders composed of an incompressible core coated with a thin compressible film. In theory, circumferential wrinkles with axial wavefronts may appear on the outer surface when the cylinder is stretched. We analyze these instabilities through modelling, numerics, finite element simulations, and controlled experiments. We show that the wrinkle amplitude and wavelength depend on the Poisson ratio of the coating and the ratio of the film and substrate shear moduli. We find that the lower the film's Poisson ratio, the earlier the wrinkles emerge under tension. This observation motivates us to use auxetic films (with negative Poisson ratios) with bespoke microstructures in the finite element simulations and the experiments. For the latter, we fabricated 3D-printed soft cylinders with stiff auxetic outer layers and subjected them to axial loading. Although simulations predicted clear wrinkle formation, experimental observation proved more elusive due to the small amplitude of the wrinkles.
summary: 我们研究了双层圆柱体的近表面张力不稳定性，该双层圆柱体由涂有薄可压缩薄膜的不可压缩核心组成。理论上，当圆柱体拉伸时，外表面可能会出现具有轴向波前的周向皱纹。我们通过建模、数值、有限元模拟和受控实验来分析这些不稳定性。我们表明，皱纹幅度和波长取决于涂层的泊松比以及薄膜和基材剪切模量的比率。我们发现薄膜的泊松比越低，在张力下皱纹出现得越早。这一观察促使我们在有限元模拟和实验中使用具有定制微观结构的拉胀薄膜（具有负泊松比）。对于后者，我们制造了具有刚性拉胀外层的 3D 打印软圆柱体，并使其承受轴向载荷。尽管模拟预测了明显的皱纹形成，但由于皱纹的幅度较小，实验观察证明更加难以捉摸。

title: Multipartite entanglement spreads
abstract: The entanglement structure of a bipartite pure state is characterized by its entanglement spectrum, or equivalently, by the family of Rényi-$k$ entanglement entropies with integer $k$. Taking the difference of two such entropies defines a quantity known as an entanglement spread, that is monotonous under local operations, and that vanishes if and only if the entanglement spectrum of the state is flat. We introduce a multipartite generalization of this notion which, for a fixed number $D\geq 3$ of parties, results in a collection of maps indexed by pairs of $D$-edge-colored graphs (obeying some condition). Each member of this collection takes the form of a difference of two multipartite Rényi entanglement entropies, each associated to a local unitary polynomial invariant (known in this context as a trace-invariant), and is shown to be monotonous under local operations. We then argue that a previously introduced family of so-called hypergraph-tensor (HT) states can be understood as a multipartite counterpart to the family of flat bipartite states. Indeed, we first prove that, when $D=3$, a tripartite pure state is HT if and only if it minimizes a particular (infinite) family of entanglement spreads. Second, we embed the set of HT states into the much larger family of spectral hypergraph-tensor (SHT) states, defined by a new Ansatz we introduce. We then prove that HT states can be uniquely characterized as the minimizers of some fixed entanglement spread among SHT states, for arbitrary $D\geq 3$. We also investigate SHT states in their own right: in particular, we characterize their orbits under local unitary transformations. Finally, along the way, the asymptotic large-$N$ expectation values of a number of entanglement spreads are computed in the Haar-random state of local dimension $N$.
summary:
二分纯态的纠缠结构由其纠缠谱来表征，或者等效地由具有整数$k$的Rényi-$k$纠缠熵族来表征。取两个这样的熵的差定义了一个称为纠缠扩展的量，该量在局部操作下是单调的，并且当且仅当状态的纠缠谱平坦时才会消失。我们引入了这个概念的多部分概括，对于固定数量的 $D\geq 3$ 各方，会产生由 $D$ 边缘彩色图对索引的地图集合（遵守某些条件）。该集合的每个成员均采用两个多部分 Rényi 纠缠熵的差值形式，每个熵与局部酉多项式不变量（在本文中称为迹不变量）相关联，并且在局部运算下显示为单调。然后我们认为，先前引入的所谓超图张量（HT）状态族可以被理解为平坦二分状态族的多部分对应物。

事实上，我们首先证明，当 $D=3$ 时，三方纯态是 HT 当且仅当它最小化特定（无限）族的纠缠扩散。其次，我们将 HT 状态集嵌入到更大的谱超图张量 (SHT) 状态族中，由我们引入的新 Ansatz 定义。然后我们证明，对于任意 $D\geq 3$，HT 状态可以唯一地表征为 SHT 状态之间某些固定纠缠扩散的最小化。我们还研究了 SHT 状态本身：特别是，我们在局部酉变换下描述了它们的轨道。最后，在此过程中，在局部维度 $N$ 的哈尔随机状态下计算多个纠缠扩展的渐近大 $N$ 期望值。

title: Wave packets asymptotics in $κ$-minkowski space
abstract: In this paper, we study the nature of wave packets and their decay behavior in the $\kappa$-Minkowski space. We employ techniques from singularity theory throughout our analysis. Specifically, we use methods from the theory of Lagrangian singularities and caustics to study the topology of the energy-level manifold. The Newton polyhedron method from the theory of oscillatory integrals is applied to analyze the decay behavior of wave packets. We find that for a generic Hamiltonian in the $\kappa$-Minkowski space, the associated wave packets exhibit different decay rates depending on the control parameter of the system. When the control parameter takes values on the cusp, the system exhibits decay of order $t^{-1/4}$; otherwise, it exhibits decay of order $t^{-1/2}$. This distinctive behavior of wave packets in the $\kappa$-Minkowski makes it fundamentally different from commutative spacetime.
summary: 在本文中，我们研究了波包的性质及其在 $\kappa$-Minkowski 空间中的衰减行为。我们在整个分析过程中采用了奇点理论的技术。具体来说，我们使用拉格朗日奇点和焦散理论的方法来研究能级流形的拓扑。应用振荡积分理论中的牛顿多面体方法来分析波包的衰减行为。我们发现，对于 $\kappa$-Minkowski 空间中的通用哈密顿量，相关波包根据系统的控制参数表现出不同的衰减率。当控制参数取尖点值时，系统呈现$t^{-1/4}$阶衰减；否则，它会表现出 $t^{-1/2}$ 阶的衰减。 $\kappa$-Minkowski 中波包的这种独特行为使其与交换时空有着根本的不同。

title: Quantum non-Markovian response spectra
abstract: Quantum systems are rarely isolated from their surroundings. These hidden environments can retain information and return it later, producing correlated errors in quantum computers and complicating the interpretation of this http URL a quantum processor, for example, one job can therefore leave an environmental trace that affects the next, even after the qubits themselves have been reset. Learning how this hidden influence persists and affects later behavior is therefore important, but the environment is often impossible to measure directly, and fully reconstructing its effects through tomography rapidly becomes impractical. Here, we introduce a response matrix that uses controlled interventions and observations of the system alone to reveal the temporal structure of environmental memory. The matrix records how future observations change across different controlled histories. Its spectrum characterizes how memory is structured and how it persists under specified system resets, while suitable linear combinations of its entries can rule out specified classical models of that memory. Because its history-future queries can be evaluated independently, numerical response matrices can be assembled in parallel. We establish the framework theoretically, characterize response spectra in an interacting spin process, and certify quantum memory in a two-qubit benchmark. This approach turns system observations into a probe of inaccessible environments and could support the diagnosis of correlated noise, tests of open system models, and memory-aware control design.
summary:
量子系统很少与周围环境隔离。这些隐藏的环境可以保留信息并稍后返回，从而在量子计算机中产生相关错误，并使量子处理器对这个 http URL 的解释复杂化，例如，一项工作可能会留下影响下一项工作的环境痕迹，即使在量子位本身已重置之后也是如此。因此，了解这种隐藏的影响如何持续存在并影响以后的行为非常重要，但环境通常无法直接测量，并且通过断层扫描快速完全重建其影响变得不切实际。在这里，我们引入了一个响应矩阵，该矩阵仅使用受控干预和对系统的观察来揭示环境记忆的时间结构。该矩阵记录了未来的观察结果在不同的受控历史中如何变化。它的频谱表征了内存的结构以及它在指定的系统重置下如何持续存在，而其条目的适当线性组合可以排除该内存的指定经典模型。

因为它的历史-未来查询可以独立评估，所以可以并行组装数值响应矩阵。我们从理论上建立了框架，表征了相互作用的自旋过程中的响应谱，并在两个量子位基准中验证了量子存储器。这种方法将系统观察转化为对不可访问环境的探测，并且可以支持相关噪声的诊断、开放系统模型的测试和内存感知控制设计。

title: On linearity or non-linearity in machine learning for quantum chaotic dynamics
abstract: Accurately simulating chaotic quantum many-body dynamics remains a major computational challenge for classical methods, due to the rapid buildup and spatial spreading of entanglement during the evolution. This raises the question of whether machine learning can provide an effective alternative for predicting quantum dynamics. We address this question by formulating quantum dynamics as a time-series forecasting problem, using a few-qubit PXP chain, realizable with Rydberg-atom arrays, as a benchmark. By varying the initial state, the system spans dynamical regimes ranging from ergodic behavior to quantum many-body scarring, providing a controlled setting for testing forecasting models across qualitatively different dynamics. We compare two contrasting architectures: an expressive nonlinear Transformer and DLinear, a simple linear forecasting model.
