The Transformer accurately predicts dynamics in the more ergodic regime, but its performance progressively deteriorates as the initial state approaches the scarred limit. In contrast, DLinear remains accurate across the entire family of initial states, with its main deviations consisting of small high-frequency oscillations that have little effect on the overall prediction error. Remarkably, these results show that observables generated by complex quantum many-body dynamics can be forecast with high accuracy through a simple linear mapping from past to future observations. This reveals that the complexity of the underlying quantum evolution need not translate into an equally complex forecasting problem.
summary:
由于演化过程中纠缠的快速积累和空间扩散，准确模拟混沌量子多体动力学仍然是经典方法的主要计算挑战。这就提出了一个问题：机器学习是否可以为预测量子动力学提供有效的替代方案。我们通过将量子动力学表述为时间序列预测问题来解决这个问题，并使用可通过里德堡原子阵列实现的几个量子位 PXP 链作为基准。通过改变初始状态，该系统跨越了从遍历行为到量子多体疤痕的动态范围，为跨定性不同的动态测试预测模型提供了受控设置。我们比较了两种截然不同的架构：富有表现力的非线性 Transformer 和 DLinear（一种简单的线性预测模型）。 Transformer 准确地预测了更遍历状态下的动态，但随着初始状态接近伤痕极限，其性能逐渐恶化。

相比之下，DLinear 在整个初始状态族中保持准确，其主要偏差包括对整体预测误差影响很小的小型高频振荡。值得注意的是，这些结果表明，通过从过去到未来的观测的简单线性映射，可以高精度地预测由复杂的量子多体动力学产生的可观测值。这表明，潜在量子演化的复杂性不必转化为同样复杂的预测问题。

title: Combining Error Verification and Privacy Amplification in Quantum Key Distribution
abstract: Quantum Key Distribution (QKD) protocols typically involve two separate steps of error-verification and privacy amplification. Both steps involve the application of a hash function sampled from a suitable hash family to classical data. A potentially simpler alternative is to implement a single-step hashing procedure, announce and compare a fixed number of bits of its output for error-verification, and retain the remaining bits as the final output key. This reduces the complexity of classical postprocessing, the amount of classical communication, and the amount of randomness needed in the protocol. While this construction has appeared in the literature, a suitable mathematical justification is lacking. In this work, we show that the security of such protocols, under certain simple conditions, follows from a slightly modified notion of secrecy of the protocol without the final error-verification step. In particular, we show that for most entropy-based proofs, the combined protocol can be implemented with no change to the key rate, and a minor change to the security parameter.
summary: 量子密钥分发 (QKD) 协议通常涉及错误验证和隐私放大两个单独的步骤。这两个步骤都涉及将从合适的哈希族中采样的哈希函数应用于经典数据。一种可能更简单的替代方案是实现单步哈希过程，宣布并比较其输出的固定位数以进行错误验证，并保留剩余位作为最终输出密钥。这降低了经典后处理的复杂性、经典通信量以及协议中所需的随机性量。虽然这种结构已经出现在文献中，但缺乏合适的数学论证。在这项工作中，我们表明，在某些简单条件下，此类协议的安全性源自协议保密概念的稍微修改，而无需最终的错误验证步骤。特别是，我们表明，对于大多数基于熵的证明，可以在不改变密钥速率并且对安全参数进行微小改变的情况下实现组合协议。

title: Single-shot magic state factories for quantum LDPC codes
abstract: Quantum low-density parity-check (qLDPC) codes can substantially reduce the qubit overhead of fault-tolerant quantum computation, but any useful architecture based on such codes also requires an efficient mechanism to implement non-Clifford gates in a fault-tolerant manner. We introduce a space-time-efficient magic state factory for high-rate qLDPC codes by combining the transversal non-Clifford gates of recently developed tricycle codes with single-shot four-dimensional balanced product quadcycle codes. The key ingredient is an efficient "escape" mechanism that teleports postselected logical magic states from tricycle codes to larger distance quadcycle codes. Under a standard circuit-level noise model at physical error rate $10^{-3}$, our factories produce $\mathrm{CCZ}$ states at logical error rates as low as $10^{-9}$ with 10-40 times lower space-time cost than state-of-the-art magic state generation methods. The resulting states are directly encoded in high-rate blocks suitable for computation. We identify the quadcycle codes by an AI-assisted search and show that they can serve as excellent memories capable of single-shot error correction. Finally, we present a concrete implementation of the entire factory with highly efficient atom transport on reconfigurable neutral-atom quantum computers. Together, these results provide an end-to-end, practical protocol for producing and utilizing high-fidelity magic states within a high-rate qLDPC architecture, with the lowest space-time cost to date.
summary:
量子低密度奇偶校验（qLDPC）代码可以大大减少容错量子计算的量子位开销，但任何基于此类代码的有用架构还需要一种有效的机制来以容错方式实现非 Clifford 门。我们通过将最近开发的三轮码的横向非 Clifford 门与单次四维平衡乘积四轮码相结合，引入了一种用于高速率 qLDPC 码的时空高效的神奇状态工厂。关键要素是一种有效的“逃逸”机制，可将选定后的逻辑魔法状态从三轮代码传送到更远距离的四轮代码。在物理错误率为 $10^{-3}$ 的标准电路级噪声模型下，我们的工厂以低至 $10^{-9}$ 的逻辑错误率生成 $\mathrm{CCZ}$ 状态，且时空成本比最先进的魔法状态生成方法低 10-40 倍。结果状态直接编码在适合计算的高速块中。我们通过人工智能辅助搜索识别了四周期代码，并表明它们可以作为能够进行单次纠错的优秀存储器。

最后，我们提出了整个工厂在可重构中性原子量子计算机上高效原子传输的具体实现。总之，这些结果提供了一种端到端的实用协议，用于在高速 qLDPC 架构中生成和利用高保真幻态，并且具有迄今为止最低的时空成本。

title: Engineering Quantum Interactions: From Effective Models to Validated Physical Predictions
abstract: Effective models make complex quantum dynamics tractable by retaining only the states, processes, and timescales relevant to a given physical question. Their predictive power, however, depends on treating the retained manifold, initial state, observables, micromotion, dissipative channels, and eliminated degrees of freedom consistently. We develop a unified framework for constructing and validating effective descriptions using projection methods, Schrieffer--Wolff transformations, Magnus expansions, adiabatic elimination, small rotations, time coarse graining, and Floquet theory. The quantum Rabi model and its dispersive limits serve as recurring benchmarks for identifying control parameters, virtual processes, spectral corrections, observable dressing, and breakdown. Higher-order resonances and applications to collective light--matter coupling, Raman processes, spin-chain buses, lossy mediators, and driven lattices illustrate how effective interactions can be interpreted and designed. A physical prediction is organized into three order-consistent steps: encoding into the retained description, evolution under the effective dynamics, and reconstruction of the physical observable. This viewpoint exposes failures caused by leakage, small denominators, neglected micromotion, inconsistent observables, memory effects, or incorrectly transformed dissipation, while linking derivation, physical interpretation, and mechanism-guided discovery. Companion notebooks provide QuTiP implementations, convergence tests, and microscopic-to-effective comparisons.
summary:
有效的模型通过仅保留与给定物理问题相关的状态、过程和时间尺度，使复杂的量子动力学变得易于处理。然而，它们的预测能力取决于对保留流形、初始状态、可观测量、微运动、耗散通道和消除自由度的一致处理。我们开发了一个统一的框架，用于使用投影方法、Schrieffer-Wolff 变换、马格努斯展开、绝热消除、小旋转、时间粗粒度和 Floquet 理论来构建和验证有效描述。量子拉比模型及其色散极限可作为识别控制参数、虚拟过程、光谱校正、可观察修整和故障的反复基准。高阶共振及其在集体光物质耦合、拉曼过程、自旋链总线、有损介体和驱动晶格中的应用说明了如何解释和设计有效的相互作用。物理预测被组织成三个顺序一致的步骤：编码到保留的描述中、有效动力学下的演化以及物理可观测值的重建。

这种观点揭示了由泄漏、小分母、被忽视的微动、不一致的可观测值、记忆效应或错误转换的耗散引起的故障，同时将推导、物理解释和机制引导的发现联系起来。配套笔记本提供 QuTiP 实现、收敛测试以及微观到有效的比较。

title: Scaling Quantum Optimization to the Thousand-Qubit Scale with Distributed Quantum Sampling
abstract: The Minimum Birkhoff Decomposition (MBD) seeks a sparse weighted sum of matchings and is a challenging optimization problem with applications in network scheduling and energy trading. We scale a quantum-assisted decomposition method by combining single-layer QAOA sampling with Extended Fully-Corrective Frank-Wolfe (E-FCFW) optimization, spectral graph partitioning, and greedy feasibility repair. We demonstrate the pipeline on the 1,354-node PEGASE bus test case (representing a 1,354-bus transmission grid with 1,710 transmission lines), whose 1,710 edges define a native 1,710-variable matching optimization problem requiring 1,710 qubits in the unpartitioned encoding. Partitioning enables distributed execution on IBM superconducting quantum processors. The best reported hardware result uses a 50-qubit partition bound, while reducing partitions to 20 qubits degrades convergence in the partition-size comparison. Larger partitions are more demanding for matrix product state (MPS) simulation, and bond-dimension tests show that truncating quantum correlations reduces candidate quality. The results therefore motivate retaining a substantive quantum sampling task within each partition as the overall problem scales. On the PEGASE-1354 benchmark, repaired QAOA samples achieve lower residual decomposition error than both simulated annealing and uniform random sampling baselines, while spatial circuit packing reduces hardware execution time by approximately a factor of three. These results demonstrate that combining spectral partitioning, spatial circuit packing, and classical feasibility repair provides an executable path for deploying gate-based quantum sampling on thousand-variable constrained optimization problems on current hardware.
summary:
最小伯克霍夫分解 (MBD) 寻求稀疏加权匹配和，是网络调度和能源交易应用中具有挑战性的优化问题。我们通过将单层 QAOA 采样与扩展完全校正 Frank-Wolfe (E-FCFW) 优化、谱图划分和贪婪可行性修复相结合来扩展量子辅助分解方法。我们在 1,354 节点 PEGASE 总线测试用例（代表具有 1,710 条传输线的 1,354 总线传输网格）上演示了管道，其 1,710 个边定义了一个原生 1,710 变量匹配优化问题，在未分区编码中需要 1,710 个量子位。分区支持在 IBM 超导量子处理器上进行分布式执行。报告的最佳硬件结果使用 50 量子位分区界限，而将分区减少到 20 量子位会降低分区大小比较中的收敛性。较大的分区对矩阵积态 (MPS) 模拟的要求更高，键维测试表明截断量子相关性会降低候选质量。

因此，随着整体问题的规模扩大，结果促使在每个分区内保留实质性的量子采样任务。在 PEGASE-1354 基准上，修复的 QAOA 样本比模拟退火和均匀随机采样基线实现更低的残余分解误差，而空间电路封装将硬件执行时间减少了大约三倍。这些结果表明，将谱划分、空间电路封装和经典可行性修复相结合，为在当前硬件上的千变量约束优化问题上部署基于门的量子采样提供了可执行路径。

title: Helicity decoupling ultrastrong Rabi splitting from quantum vacuum dressing
abstract: Polaritons and quantum vacuum dressing are usually regarded as intertwined consequences of ultrastrong light-matter coupling. Here we show that they can be controlled independently through helicity. We consider cyclotron resonance coupled to a chiral cavity supporting a single circular mode. When the helicity of the cavity field matches the cyclotron motion, energy is exchanged resonantly between light and matter, producing a large Rabi splitting and conventional polaritons, while the ground state remains the bare vacuum. Reversing the magnetic field reverses the cyclotron motion without changing the cavity. The same mode then couples through anomalous processes that create and annihilate light and matter excitations in pairs: the conventional polaritonic anticrossing disappears, while the ground state acquires squeezing and virtual excitations. These two regimes show that spectral hybridization and quantum vacuum dressing are distinct manifestations of ultrastrong coupling, and that a large Rabi splitting alone does not imply a dressed quantum vacuum. Helicity therefore provides a route to controlling polariton formation and quantum correlations as distinct resources in cavity quantum materials.
summary:
极化子和量子真空敷料通常被认为是超强光与物质耦合的交织结果。在这里我们证明它们可以通过螺旋度独立控制。我们考虑与支持单圆模式的手性腔耦合的回旋加速器共振。当腔场的螺旋度与回旋加速器运动相匹配时，能量在光和物质之间共振交换，产生大的拉比分裂和传统的极化激元，而基态仍然是裸露的真空。反转磁场会反转回旋加速器的运动，而不改变腔体。然后，相同的模式通过异常过程耦合，成对地产生和湮灭光和物质激发：传统的极化子反交叉消失，而基态获得挤压和虚拟激发。这两种情况表明，光谱杂化和量子真空修饰是超强耦合的不同表现，并且单独的大拉比分裂并不意味着修饰的量子真空。

因此，螺旋性提供了一种控制极化子形成和量子相关性作为腔量子材料中不同资源的途径。

title: High-Rate Concatenated Quantum Error-Correcting Codes for Qudits
abstract: Qudits provide a larger local Hilbert space than qubits and have recently attracted interest as building blocks for efficient fault-tolerant quantum computation (FTQC). In this work, we extend many-hypercube (MHC) codes, high-rate concatenated quantum codes, from qubits to qudits of prime dimension $q$. We construct the level-2 and level-3 MHC codes with parameters $\left[\!\left[6^2,4^2,2^2\right]\!\right]_q$ and $\left[\!\left[6^3,4^3,2^3\right]\!\right]_q$, respectively, and generalize the level-by-level minimum-distance (LLMD) decoder originally proposed for the qubit MHC codes. In a qudit $X$-error model, we evaluate the code-capacity performance of the qudit MHC codes for dimensions up to $q=13$. We find that the error threshold increases monotonically with the local dimension $q$, reaching $10.0\%$ for $q=13$, nearly double the value of $5.1\%$ for qubits. Furthermore, for sufficiently large local dimensions, we observe a pronounced waterfall regime in which the logical error rate decreases substantially faster than expected from conventional distance-based estimates. To understand the origin of the observed qudit advantage, we analyze the decoding performance in terms of the entropy of the underlying $q$-ary noise channel. This analysis reveals a competition between the increased syndrome information available at larger $q$ and the simultaneous growth of the typical physical error weight at fixed entropy. These results demonstrate that higher-dimensional quantum systems can substantially improve the performance of high-rate concatenated quantum codes and motivate further development of qudit-based FTQC architectures.
summary:
Qudits 提供了比量子位更大的局部希尔伯特空间，并且最近作为高效容错量子计算 (FTQC) 的构建块引起了人们的兴趣。在这项工作中，我们将多超立方体 (MHC) 代码（即高速级联量子代码）从量子位扩展到素数维度 $q$ 的量子位。我们分别使用参数 $\left[\!\left[6^2,4^2,2^2\right]\!\right]_q$ 和 $\left[\!\left[6^3,4^3,2^3\right]\!\right]_q$ 构造 2 级和 3 级 MHC 代码，并推广最初为量子位 MHC 代码提出的逐级最小距离（LLMD）解码器。在 qdit $X$ 错误模型中，我们评估了 qdit MHC 代码的代码容量性能，维度高达 $q=13$。我们发现误差阈值随着局部维度 $q$ 单调增加，当 $q=13$ 时达到 $10.0\%$，几乎是量子位 $5.1\%$ 值的两倍。此外，对于足够大的局部维度，我们观察到明显的瀑布状态，其中逻辑错误率的下降速度比传统的基于距离的估计的预期要快得多。

为了理解观察到的 qudit 优势的起源，我们根据底层 $q$-ary 噪声通道的熵来分析解码性能。该分析揭示了较大 $q$ 下可用的症状信息增加与固定熵下典型物理误差权重同时增长之间的竞争。这些结果表明，高维量子系统可以显着提高高速级联量子码的性能，并推动基于 qdit 的 FTQC 架构的进一步开发。

title: Exact polariton-condensate states via nonlinear Stark coupling
abstract: We study a hybrid system of coupled cavities, with or without two-level atoms doped inside. By employing a building-block construction facilitated by nonlinear Stark coupling, we identify a manifold of exact many-body eigenstates that remain analytically tractable across arbitrary lattice geometries and atom distributions. We demonstrate that these exact states exhibit a dual physical nature depending on their spectral positioning: when embedded within the chaotic many-body spectrum, they manifest as quantum scars that violate the eigenstate thermalization hypothesis and undergo weak ergodicity breaking; conversely, as ground states within fixed-total-excitation sectors, they exhibit off-diagonal long-range order and form polariton condensates. Furthermore, numerical calculations of local excitation-number fluctuations suggest that negative Stark coupling shifts the Mott-insulator to superfluid transition toward weaker inter-cavity hopping. Our findings provide a versatile framework for engineering both coherent quantum phases and non-thermalizing states in diverse light-matter architectures.
summary: 我们研究了耦合腔的混合系统，内部掺杂或不掺杂两级原子。通过采用非线性斯塔克耦合促进的构建块结构，我们识别了多种精确的多体本征态，这些本征态在任意晶格几何形状和原子分布上仍然保持分析可处理性。我们证明，这些确切的状态根据其光谱定位而表现出双重物理性质：当嵌入混沌多体光谱中时，它们表现为违反本征态热化假说并经历弱遍历性破坏的量子疤痕；相反，作为固定总激发扇区内的基态，它们表现出非对角长程有序并形成极化子凝聚体。此外，局部激发数波动的数值计算表明，负斯塔克耦合使莫特绝缘体向超流体过渡转向较弱的腔间跳跃。我们的研究结果为在不同的光物质结构中设计相干量子相和非热化态提供了一个通用的框架。

title: Topological Superradiant Universality Classes in Cavity-Mediated Spin Chains
abstract: Superradiant phase transitions are fundamental phenomena in light-matter coupled systems. Here, we uncover a novel class of superradiant criticality that is topologically distinct from previously known superradiant transitions. Using cavity-mediated cluster-Ising chains as an illustrative example, we numerically demonstrate that the critical line separating the superradiant phase from the cavity topological phase hosts robust symmetry-protected edge degeneracies, a feature absent in conventional superradiant transitions. Remarkably, although its local bulk critical properties are indistinguishable from those of the previously identified topologically trivial superradiant transition, the two criticalities cannot be smoothly connected without breaking the protecting symmetries or passing through a multicritical point. We further show that such topological superradiant criticality is generic, also occurring in cavity-mediated $\mathbb{Z}_{n}^{}$ cluster-qudit chains, as supported by complementary lattice simulations.
summary: 超辐射相变是光-物质耦合系统中的基本现象。在这里，我们发现了一类新颖的超辐射临界性，它在拓扑上与之前已知的超辐射跃迁不同。使用空腔介导的簇伊辛链作为说明性示例，我们在数值上证明了将超辐射相与空腔拓扑相分开的临界线具有鲁棒的对称保护边缘简并性，这是传统超辐射跃迁中不存在的特征。值得注意的是，尽管其局部体临界性质与先前确定的拓扑平凡超辐射转变的性质没有区别，但在不破坏保护对称性或通过多临界点的情况下，这两个临界性质无法平滑连接。我们进一步表明，这种拓扑超辐射临界性是通用的，也发生在空腔介导的 $\mathbb{Z}_{n}^{}$ cluster-qudit 链中，正如互补晶格模拟所支持的那样。

title: A Power-Liouville Hermite Orbit: Common Spectral Quantization of the Singular Sextic Oscillator and Fractional-Power Potentials
abstract: A singular sextic oscillator in the finite-Hermite biconfluent-Heun hierarchy generates an exact four-member power-Liouville Hermite orbit. Power coordinate transformations with the Liouville amplitude map the hierarchy member $N=4$ to four half-line Schrödinger spectral charts while preserving the physical regular-recessive Wronskian zero set under energy-coupling reparametrization. Two charts are the previously studied $x^{2/3}$ and inverse-square-root conditionally integrable potentials; the orbit embeds this known power-dual pair together with the singular sextic and linear-plus-quadratic charts. On the selected physical slice, the degree-five accessory compatibility obstruction vanishes identically, while the transformed Frobenius index reproduces both published fractional-power centrifugal coefficients. The common endpoint condition yields an exact discrete sequence of quartic Sturmian eigencouplings for the sextic oscillator. Independent two-sided shooting confirms representative eigencouplings and node counts. A matched large-action analysis further derives the first matched-endpoint correction within the leading Langer action and improves the Maslov-shifted effective-level approximation. The construction thus connects exact Hermite solvability, energy quantization, coupling quantization, and power duality within a single spectral orbit.
summary:
有限 Hermite 双汇合 Heun 层次结构中的奇异六角振子生成精确的四元幂-Liouville Hermite 轨道。具有刘维尔振幅的幂坐标变换将层次结构成员 $N=4$ 映射到四个半线薛定谔谱图，同时在能量耦合重参数化下保留物理规则隐性朗斯基零集。两张图分别是之前研究的$x^{2/3}$和反平方根条件可积势；轨道将这个已知的幂对偶对与奇异六次图表和线性加二次图表一起嵌入。在选定的物理切片上，五度附件兼容性障碍同样消失，而变换后的弗罗贝尼乌斯指数再现了两个已发布的分数功率离心系数。公共端点条件产生六次振子的四次 Sturmian 特征耦合的精确离散序列。独立的两侧拍摄确认了代表性的特征耦合和节点数。

匹配的大动作分析进一步导出了领先的兰格动作内的第一个匹配端点校正，并改进了马斯洛夫移位的有效水平近似。因此，该结构将精确的埃尔米特可解性、能量量化、耦合量化和功率对偶性连接在单个光谱轨道内。

title: Remote nonreciprocal magnon magnon entanglement via the Barnett effect with coherent feedback
abstract: We propose a scheme for generating and controlling remote nonreciprocal magnon--magnon entanglement in a cavity magnonic system with coherent this http URL two microwave cavities are driven by independent single-mode squeezed vacuum fields, with a rotating YIG sphere in the left cavity and a stationary one in the right cavity. For a fixed rotation direction, reversing the bias magnetic field applied to the rotating sphere changes the sign of the Barnett shift, leading to nonreciprocal magnon--magnon entanglement. By tuning the cavity detuning and feedback phase, entanglement can be generated for one direction of the bias magnetic field while it vanishes for the opposite direction, yielding complete nonreciprocity. Coherent feedback enhances the entanglement at an appropriate reflectivity, whereas stronger feedback can reduce it. The relative squeezing phase provides additional control, and an appropriate choice of unequal squeezing factors improves the entanglement at fixed total input photon occupation. With the squeezed inputs kept fixed, moderate feedback also increases the critical temperature for magnon this http URL results provide a controllable approach to preparing remote nonreciprocal quantum correlations in cavity magnonic systems.
summary:
我们提出了一种在腔磁振子系统中产生和控制远程不可逆磁振子的方案，该系统具有相干的http URL，两个微波腔由独立的单模压缩真空场驱动，左腔中有一个旋转的YIG球，右腔中有一个静止的YIG球。对于固定的旋转方向，反转施加到旋转球体的偏置磁场会改变巴尼特位移的符号，导致不可逆磁振子-磁振子纠缠。通过调整腔失谐和反馈相位，可以在偏置磁场的一个方向上产生纠缠，而在相反方向上纠缠消失，从而产生完全的非互易性。相干反馈可以增强适当反射率下的纠缠，而更强的反馈可以减少纠缠。相对压缩相位提供了额外的控制，并且适当选择不相等的压缩因子可以改善固定总输入光子占用下的纠缠。

随着压缩输入保持固定，适度的反馈也会增加磁振子的临界温度，该 http URL 结果提供了一种可控方法来准备腔磁振子系统中的远程非互易量子相关性。

title: Extended Results on Absorbing Boundary Conditions as Limits of Complex Potentials
abstract: In quantum mechanics, among the proposals for how to compute the probability distribution of detection time and place along a given spatial surface or in a given volume, two leading candidates involve absorbing boundary conditions (ABCs) and complex absorbing potentials (CAPs) for the Schrödinger equation. Here, we extend earlier results on how the two are related. It was previously shown that ABCs arise as a limiting case of CAPs, but for that a (reflecting) Neumann boundary condition was assumed at the end of the region with the CAP. Here, we obtain ABCs in a different limit using a Dirichlet boundary condition at the end of the CAP region, which seems more practically relevant and realizable.
summary: 在量子力学中，在如何计算沿给定空间表面或给定体积内的检测时间和位置的概率分布的建议中，两个主要候选者涉及薛定谔方程的吸收边界条件（ABC）和复吸收势（CAP）。在这里，我们扩展了之前关于两者之间关系的结果。先前表明 ABC 是作为 CAP 的极限情况出现的，但为此在 CAP 区域的末端假设了（反映）诺依曼边界条件。在这里，我们在 CAP 区域末端使用狄利克雷边界条件获得了不同极限的 ABC，这似乎更具有实际意义和可实现性。

title: From Majorana to Bloch: two ways to generalize the Bloch sphere representation
abstract: While the Bloch sphere provides a canonical geometric representation for qubits, its generalization to pure qudit states ($d>2$) is not unique. This representation can be extended following two different approaches: increasing the number of points, as in the Majorana representation, or using a single point but in a space of larger dimension, as in the generalized Bloch representation. In this work, we compare these representations of pure qudit states by finding explicit analytical relations between them. In particular, a general formula of the Bloch vector in terms of the Majorana points of a given state is provided. We also analyze some suitable extensions of these representations in the case of pure permutation-symmetric two- and three-qubit states, deriving the corresponding relation between them. These analytical results allow us to study, from a geometric point of view, quantum correlations of special classes of two-qubit states.
summary: 虽然布洛赫球体为量子位提供了规范的几何表示，但它对纯量子状态 ($d>2$) 的推广并不是唯一的。这种表示可以通过两种不同的方法进行扩展：增加点的数量，如在马约拉纳表示中，或者在更大维度的空间中使用单个点，如在广义布洛赫表示中。在这项工作中，我们通过寻找纯 Qudit 状态之间的明确分析关系来比较这些表示。特别地，提供了根据给定状态的马约拉纳点的布洛赫向量的通式。我们还分析了在纯排列对称二量子位和三量子位状态的情况下这些表示的一些合适的扩展，推导了它们之间的对应关系。这些分析结果使我们能够从几何角度研究特殊类别的两量子位态的量子相关性。

title: Unitary-accessible coherence-erasure distance: Exact qubit solution and a tight qutrit bound
abstract: We introduce the unitary-accessible coherence-erasure distance, which measures the minimum unitary-control cost required to transform a quantum state into an incoherent state without changing its spectrum. The target states are restricted to incoherent states on the same unitary orbit, leading to a geometry different from conventional state-space proximity. We establish inequalities relating orbit-restricted quantum transport, Bures geometry, and the unitary-control distance. These quantities coincide for pure states but can differ for mixed states. For qubits, we derive an exact expression and show that, in the nondegenerate case, the coherence-erasure cost depends on the eigenbasis orientation rather than on the eigenvalues. For nondegenerate qutrits, we reduce the problem to an optimization over the monomial unitary group. We derive the tight universal bound $\arccos[(2\sqrt2-1)/4]$ and construct an explicit eigenbasis that attains it. The resulting distance also determines the minimum coherence-erasure time under bounded unitary driving, giving it a direct operational meaning.
summary: 我们引入了单一可达相干擦除距离，它测量将量子态转变为非相干态而不改变其光谱所需的最小单一控制成本。目标态仅限于同一酉轨道上的非相干态，导致几何形状不同于传统的状态空间邻近度。我们建立了与轨道限制量子传输、布尔几何和单一控制距离相关的不等式。这些量对于纯态而言是一致的，但对于混合态而言可能不同。对于量子位，我们推导了一个精确的表达式，并表明，在非简并情况下，相干性擦除成本取决于特征基方向而不是特征值。对于非简并四元组，我们将问题简化为单项酉群的优化。我们导出紧通用界限 $\arccos[(2\sqrt2-1)/4]$ 并构造一个获得它的显式特征基。由此产生的距离还决定了有界酉驱动下的最小相干擦除时间，赋予其直接的操作意义。

title: On the separability of Bell-diagonal states with absolutely positive partial transposition
abstract: Absolutely positive partial transpose (APPT) states, which remain PPT under every global unitary, provide a spectral relaxation of absolutely separable states, which remain separable under every such transformation. Despite substantial progress, whether these two notions coincide beyond qubit-qudit systems remains unresolved, motivating the study of structured state families in which the APPT spectral constraints and separability can be analyzed exactly. We study this problem for Bell-diagonal states in two settings: the standard two-qutrit Weyl-Heisenberg basis and the two-ququart lattice basis generated by two-qubit Pauli operators. In the two-qutrit case, we show that a linearized necessary condition for APPT defines a polytope of spectra in which every associated Weyl-Heisenberg Bell-diagonal state admits an exact decomposition into explicitly separable states. This yields a separability criterion that applies to a region even larger than the APPT set itself. In the two-ququart lattice Bell-diagonal setting, we show that a state remains PPT under every permutation of its Bell coefficients if and only if its six largest Bell coefficients sum to at most 1/2, and we prove that all such states are separable. Equivalently, every entangled lattice Bell-diagonal state becomes NPT after a suitable coefficient permutation and is therefore not APPT. The proofs combine convex-polytope analysis, affine and symplectic orbit reductions, and exact rational decompositions into separable states supported on affine Lagrangian subsets. Our results rule out entangled APPT states in both Bell-diagonal families, and provide simple spectral inequalities as sufficient criteria for separability in both cases. Being basis-specific, however, they do not by themselves settle whether APPT and absolute separability coincide.
summary:
绝对正部分转置（APPT）态在每个全局酉态下仍然是 PPT，提供了绝对可分态的谱弛豫，在每个此类变换下仍然是可分的。尽管取得了实质性进展，但这两个概念是否在量子位-量子系统之外重合仍然悬而未决，这激发了对结构化状态族的研究，在结构化状态族中可以准确分析 APPT 谱约束和可分离性。我们在两种设置下研究贝尔对角态的这个问题：标准的二量子位 Weyl-Heisenberg 基和由二量子位泡利算子生成的二量子位格基。在二量子体的情况下，我们证明了 APPT 的线性化必要条件定义了光谱的多面体，其中每个相关的 Weyl-Heisenberg 贝尔对角态都允许精确分解为显式可分离态。这产生了适用于比 APPT 集本身更大的区域的可分离性标准。

在二夸夸特格子贝尔对角线设置中，我们证明，当且仅当其六个最大贝尔系数之和至多为 1/2 时，状态在其贝尔系数的每次排列下仍保持 PPT，并且我们证明所有此类状态都是可分离的。同样，每个纠缠晶格贝尔对角态在适当的系数排列后都变成 NPT，因此不是 APPT。该证明结合了凸多面体分析、仿射和辛轨道约简，以及精确有理分解为仿射拉格朗日子集支持的可分离状态。我们的结果排除了贝尔对角线族中的纠缠 APPT 态，并提供了简单的谱不等式作为两种情况下可分离性的充分标准。然而，由于基础特定，它们本身并不能确定 APPT 和绝对可分离性是否一致。

title: A deterministic polynomial chaos Galerkin method for non-Markovian quantum state diffusion
abstract: Developing general-purpose numerical methods for non-Markovian quantum state diffusion has long been a challenge in the simulation of open quantum systems. This paper proposes a deterministic polynomial chaos Galerkin method, which is easy to implement, accurate, and efficient. By combining a low-rank decomposition of bath correlations with Galerkin projection onto a polynomial chaos basis, the method yields a deterministic formulation compatible with standard numerical solvers for partial differential equations. The reduced density matrix is obtained from a single deterministic solve at a cost comparable to that of computing one stochastic hierarchy trajectory. Replacing an ensemble of $N_{\mathrm{traj}}$ trajectories therefore reduces the computational cost by approximately a factor of $N_{\mathrm{traj}}$ and eliminates statistical sampling error. Benchmark comparisons show that the proposed method achieves smaller errors at lower computational cost than the tested stochastic hierarchy methods. Applications involving nonquadratic potentials, diffraction and interference, and coupled three-dimensional dynamics demonstrate its ability to handle challenging problems.
summary: 开发非马尔可夫量子态扩散的通用数值方法长期以来一直是开放量子系统模拟中的一个挑战。本文提出了一种易于实现、准确、高效的确定性多项式混沌伽辽金方法。通过将浴相关性的低阶分解与多项式混沌基础上的伽辽金投影相结合，该方法产生了与偏微分方程的标准数值求解器兼容的确定性公式。降低的密度矩阵是从单个确定性求解中获得的，其成本与计算一个随机层次结构轨迹的成本相当。因此，替换 $N_{\mathrm{traj}}$ 轨迹的集合可以将计算成本降低大约 $N_{\mathrm{traj}}$ 倍，并消除统计采样误差。基准比较表明，与测试的随机层次方法相比，所提出的方法以更低的计算成本实现了更小的误差。涉及非二次势、衍射和干涉以及耦合三维动力学的应用证明了其处理具有挑战性问题的能力。

title: Nearly Optimal T-Count for Symmetry-Based Quantum State Purification
abstract: Protecting quantum information from noise is essential for reliable quantum computation and quantum memories. Quantum state purification addresses this challenge by processing multiple noisy copies of an unknown quantum state to produce an output state of higher fidelity. Here we establish nearly tight upper and lower bounds on the non-Clifford resources required to implement the symmetric-projection purification protocol. For $n$ copies of a $d$-dimensional system, we construct a Clifford+T circuit that block-encodes the symmetric projector with operator-norm error at most $\epsilon$ using $\widetilde{O}(n)$ T gates, where the tilde-$O$ notation suppresses polylogarithmic factors in $n$, $d$, and $1/\epsilon$. Conversely, using stabilizer nullity, we prove that any Clifford+T implementation of such a block encoding with error $\epsilon<\frac{1}{2}\sqrt{1-1/n}$ requires at least $2n-2$ T gates, even allowing arbitrary positive normalization and clean stabilizer ancillas. Taken together, these results establish the nearly optimal scaling of non-Clifford cost with the number of copies and uncover the fundamental resource requirements for coherent symmetry projection in quantum state purification.
summary:
保护量子信息免受噪声影响对于可靠的量子计算和量子存储器至关重要。量子态纯化通过处理未知量子态的多个噪声副本以产生更高保真度的输出状态来解决这一挑战。在这里，我们对实施对称投影纯化协议所需的非 Clifford 资源建立了近乎严格的上限和下限。对于 $d$ 维系统的 $n$ 个副本，我们构建了一个 Clifford+T 电路，该电路使用 $\widetilde{O}(n)$ T 门对对称投影仪进行块编码，运算符范数误差最多为 $\epsilon$，其中波浪号-$O$ 符号抑制 $n$、$d$ 和 $1/\epsilon$ 中的多对数因子。相反，使用稳定器无效性，我们证明任何具有错误 $\epsilon<\frac{1}{2}\sqrt{1-1/n}$ 的块编码的 Clifford+T 实现至少需要 $2n-2$ T 个门，甚至允许任意正归一化和干净的稳定器辅助。

总而言之，这些结果建立了非 Clifford 成本与副本数量的近乎最佳缩放比例，并揭示了量子态纯化中相干对称投影的基本资源需求。

title: The Imaginary Component of the Weak Momentum: Spectral Vanishing and Gauge Invariance
abstract: We establish a rigorous functional-analytic framework for the imaginary component $p_I$ of the complex weak momentum $p_Q = p_R + ip_I = \frac{\hbar}{i}\nabla\ln\psi$. For every wavefunction in the Sobolev space $H^1(\Omega)$, including those with nodal sets, we prove that the expectation value of $p_I$ vanishes identically, as a consequence of the regularity of $\rho = |\psi|^2$ and without appeal to the polar form $\psi = Re^{iS/\hbar}$. We further show that \textnormal{(i)} the Bohm quantum potential arises entirely from $p_I$ and satisfies $\langle V_{\mathrm{qu}}\rangle = \langle p_I^2\rangle/2m$, from which the known Fisher information relation follows as a corollary; \textnormal{(ii)} the group velocity of a Bloch band is the density-weighted average of $p_R/m$, with no contribution from $p_I$; \textnormal{(iii)} the decomposition is gauge-invariant under magnetic minimal coupling, the vector potential acting only on $p_R$; and \textnormal{(iv)} the results extend to curved Riemannian manifolds.
summary: 我们为复弱动量 $p_Q = p_R + ip_I = \frac{\hbar}{i}\nabla\ln\psi$ 的虚部 $p_I$ 建立了严格的泛函分析框架。对于 Sobolev 空间 $H^1(\Omega)$ 中的每个波函数，包括具有节点集的波函数，我们证明 $p_I$ 的期望值相同地消失，这是 $\rho = |\psi|^2$ 规律性的结果，并且无需诉诸极坐标形式 $\psi = Re^{iS/\hbar}$。我们进一步证明 \textnormal{(i)} 玻姆量子势完全由 $p_I$ 产生并满足 $\langle V_{\mathrm{qu}}\rangle = \langle p_I^2\rangle/2m$，由此推论已知的 Fisher 信息关系； \textnormal{(ii)} 布洛赫带的群速度是 $p_R/m$ 的密度加权平均值，没有 $p_I$ 的贡献； \textnormal{(iii)} 分解在磁最小耦合下是规范不变的，矢量势仅作用于 $p_R$；和 \textnormal{(iv)} 结果扩展到弯曲黎曼流形。

title: Quantum Co-Design of Inhomogeneous Many-Body Neutrino Fast Flavor Transformation
abstract: Dense-neutrino flavor evolution is a quantum many-body problem whose fully correlated treatment becomes rapidly more expensive with increasing particle number and spatial structure. We develop a \texttt{QCNO} quantum simulation code that maps a inhomogeneous forward-scattering neutrino Hamiltonian with advection and finite-range interactions to TEBD2 product-formula quantum circuits, and connects ideal many-body simulation, backend-aware execution, and fault-tolerant resource estimation within the same physical model. We reproduce the exact many-body evolution of the suppressed mean-field-like transverse fast flavor instability through $N=30$ and show that even a single open-boundary interaction generates Rënyi entanglement and non-stabilizer magic, although noisy backends still produce polarization RMSEs of order $0.1$--$0.3$. The restricted active interaction graph of this problem allows us to estimate the circuit depth and $T$ gate cost through $N=50$ for both NISQ and fault-tolerant approaches. The measured TEBD2 error in our fiducial ideal simulation of order $10^{-3}$ motivates a synthesis tolerance $\varepsilon_{\rm syn}\sim10^{-7}$, corresponding to about $70$ $T$ gates per $R_Z$ rotation. The generated circuit contains $1.4\times10^4$ $T$ gates per qubit for open boundaries (twice that for closed boundaries), requiring an application-level logical-$T$ error target of order $10^{-7}$ for early fault-tolerant architectures.
summary:
稠密中微子味道演化是一个量子多体问题，随着粒子数量和空间结构的增加，完全相关的处理变得更加昂贵。我们开发了一个 QCNO 量子模拟代码，它将具有平流和有限范围相互作用的非均匀前向散射中微子哈密顿量映射到 TEBD2 乘积式量子电路，并在同一物理模型中连接理想的多体模拟、后端感知执行和容错资源估计。我们通过 $N=30$ 再现了受抑制的类平均场横向快速味道不稳定性的精确多体演化，并表明即使是单个开放边界相互作用也会产生 Rënyi 纠缠和非稳定器魔力，尽管嘈杂的后端仍然会产生 $0.1$-$0.3$ 量级的极化 RMSE。该问题的受限主动交互图使我们能够通过 NISQ 和容错方法的 $N=50$ 来估计电路深度和 $T$ 门成本。

在我们的$10^{-3}$阶基准理想模拟中测得的TEBD2误差激发了综合容差$\varepsilon_{\rm syn}\sim10^{-7}$，对应于每$R_Z$旋转大约$70$$T$门。生成的电路包含开放边界每个量子位 $1.4\times10^4$ $T$ 门（封闭边界的两倍），对于早期的容错架构，需要 $10^{-7}$ 阶的应用程序级逻辑 $T$ 错误目标。

title: Improved Local Leakage Resilience of Shamir Secret Sharing and Worst-Case Optimal Polynomial Intersection
abstract: We study two problems: Local Leakage Resilience (LLR) for Shamir secret sharing, and worst-case Optimal Polynomial Intersection (OPI). Both problems concern polynomials $Q(X)$ of degree less than $k$, over a prime-order finite field $\mathbb{F}_p$. In LLR for Shamir secret sharing, one asks how much one can learn about $Q(0)$ given a few bits leaked from each of $Q(\alpha_1), \ldots, Q(\alpha_n)$, for distinct non-zero evaluation points $\alpha_i \in \mathbb{F}_p$. In OPI, one is given input list $S_1, \ldots, S_n \subset \mathbb{F}_p$, and wants to find a polynomial $Q(X)$ of degree less than $k$ so that $Q(\alpha_i) \in S_i$ for as many $i$ as possible. Leveraging recent connection between these two problems due to (Sun, Wootters 2026), we improve the state-of-the-art for both problems. For LLR, we show that there is some constant $\delta > 0$ so that, as long as $R := k/n \geq 1/2 - \delta$, Shamir secret-sharing is one-bit locally leakage resilient (meaning that one can learn only a negligible amount about $Q(0)$). This is the first result to break the so-called "one-half barrier" for LLR, and improves over the previous best known result, requiring $R \geq 0.668$ (Kasser, 2025). For OPI, we give a quantum algorithm that finds a polynomial $Q(X)$ that agrees with at least a $\mathsf{SCL}_\rho(R)-\varepsilon$ fraction of the lists in expectation, for every fixed $\varepsilon>0$, where $\mathsf{SCL}_\rho$ is the \emph{semicircle law} of (Jordan et al., 2025). This improves previous algorithmic (and existential) results of (Jo, 2026) and (Horinaga, Yamakawa, 2026). We also give further improved existential results. We also adapt the hardness result of (Yamakawa, Zhandry, 2024) to apply to OPI (rather than a folded version); over large fields, this gives an unconditional separation between the quantum and classical hardness of OPI relative to a membership oracle.
summary:
我们研究两个问题：Shamir 秘密共享的局部泄漏弹性（LLR）和最坏情况的最优多项式交集（OPI）。这两个问题都涉及素数阶有限域 $\mathbb{F}_p$ 上次数小于 $k$ 的多项式 $Q(X)$。在 Shamir 秘密共享的 LLR 中，人们会问，对于不同的非零评估点 $\alpha_i \in \mathbb{F}_p$，鉴于从 $Q(\alpha_1)、\ldots、Q(\alpha_n)$ 中的每一个泄漏的一些位，我们可以了解多少 $Q(0)$。在 OPI 中，给定输入列表 $S_1, \ldots, S_n \subset \mathbb{F}_p$，并希望找到次数小于 $k$ 的多项式 $Q(X)$，以便 $Q(\alpha_i) \in S_i$ 包含尽可能多的 $i$。利用最近由于（Sun，Wootters 2026）而产生的这两个问题之间的联系，我们改进了这两个问题的最新技术。对于 LLR，我们证明存在一些常数 $\delta > 0$，因此，只要 $R := k/n \geq 1/2 - \delta$，Shamir 秘密共享就是一位本地泄漏弹性的（这意味着人们只能了解关于 $Q(0)$ 的可忽略不计的量）。

这是第一个突破 LLR 所谓“半壁垒”的结果，并且比之前最著名的结果有所改进，需要 $R \geq 0.668$（Kasser，2025）。对于 OPI，我们给出了一种量子算法，对于每个固定的 $\varepsilon>0$，找到一个多项式 $Q(X)$，该多项式至少与期望列表中的 $\mathsf{SCL}_\rho(R)-\varepsilon$ 部分一致，其中 $\mathsf{SCL}_\rho$ 是 (Jordan et al., 2025) 的 \emph{半圆定律}。这改进了（Jo，2026）和（Horinaga，Yamakawa，2026）之前的算法（和存在主义）结果。我们还给出了进一步改进的存在结果。我们还调整了 (Yamakawa, Zhandry, 2024) 的硬度结果以应用于 OPI（而不是折叠版本）；在大范围内，这使得 OPI 相对于隶属预言机的量子硬度和经典硬度之间存在无条件分离。

title: Energy-constrained two-way capacities of the pure-loss channel
abstract: We determine the two-way quantum and secret-key capacities of the pure-loss channel under an average input photon-number constraint. For transmissivity $\eta$ and photon budget $N$, both capacities equal $g(N)-g((1-\eta)N)$, where $g$ is the entropy of a thermal state. This coincides with the rate achieved by the known reverse coherent information of a two-mode squeezed vacuum. Our result provides the last missing capacity formula for the celebrated pure-loss channel, completing the picture of bosonic quantum communication under pure loss.
summary: 我们确定了平均输入光子数约束下纯损耗通道的双向量子和密钥容量。对于透射率 $\eta$ 和光子预算 $N$，两个容量都等于 $g(N)-g((1-\eta)N)$，其中 $g$ 是热态的熵。这与已知的双模压缩真空反向相干信息所达到的速率一致。我们的结果提供了著名的纯损耗信道的最后一个缺失容量公式，完成了纯损耗下玻色子量子通信的图景。

title: Toward Joint Optimization of Circuit Depth and Training Data Size in Adaptively Grown Quantum Classifiers
abstract: Building a quantum model involves a tradeoff: how complex the circuit should be, and how much training data it needs. Caro et al. show that models with fewer trainable gates need less training data to generalize well. Q-FLAIR shows that a quantum feature-map circuit can be grown gate-by-gate, stopping once further growth stops improving the training loss. We ask whether these two results combine into a predictable scaling law. Does Q-FLAIR's own stopping rule pick larger or smaller circuits as training data grows? Does the resulting generalization behavior track Caro et al.'s bound? We reimplement Q-FLAIR's growth mechanism faithfully, including its analytic reconstruction and exact stopping rule. We run it on full-resolution (784-pixel) MNIST 3-vs-5 classification, at five training-set sizes from N = 2000 to 10000. We then fine-tune each resulting circuit, so we can measure Caro et al.'s notion of active gates, K. We find no predictable relationship between training-set size and the circuit size Q-FLAIR converges to. Circuit size and test accuracy both vary non-monotonically with N, and seed-to-seed variance is nearly as large as any trend across N. The empirical generalization gap never exceeds Caro et al.'s bound in 14 of 15 runs, so the bound holds as a valid guarantee in those runs. But the gap correlates only weakly with the bound's value (r = 0.12). This shows that K does not explain most of the variation we observe. Why a valid guarantee can coexist with such weak predictive power remains an open question, and answering it may be necessary before circuit depth and training data size can be jointly optimized in practice.
summary:
构建量子模型需要权衡：电路应该有多复杂，以及需要多少训练数据。卡罗等人。表明具有较少可训练门的模型需要较少的训练数据才能很好地泛化。 Q-FLAIR 表明，量子特征映射电路可以逐个门地增长，一旦进一步的增长停止改善训练损失，就停止。我们询问这两个结果是否结合成一个可预测的缩放定律。随着训练数据的增长，Q-FLAIR 自己的停止规则会选择更大或更小的电路吗？由此产生的泛化行为是否跟踪 Caro 等人的界限？我们忠实地重新实现了Q-FLAIR的增长机制，包括其解析重构和精确停止规则。我们在全分辨率（784 像素）MNIST 3-vs-5 分类上运行它，训练集大小从 N = 2000 到 10000。然后，我们对每个结果电路进行微调，以便我们可以测量 Caro 等人的活动门概念 K。我们发现训练集大小和 Q-FLAIR 收敛到的电路大小之间没有可预测的关系。电路尺寸和测试精度均随 N 非单调变化，并且种子间方差几乎与 N 上的任何趋势一样大。

在 15 次运行中的 14 次中，经验泛化差距从未超过 Caro 等人的界限，因此该界限在这些运行中作为有效保证成立。但差距与界限值的相关性很弱（r = 0.12）。这表明 K 并不能解释我们观察到的大部分变化。为什么有效的保证可以与如此弱的预测能力共存仍然是一个悬而未决的问题，在实践中联合优化电路深度和训练数据大小之前可能有必要回答这个问题。

title: Entanglement entropy and magic of ZX-diagrams
abstract: Entanglement and non-stabilizerness are complementary resources underlying the complexity of quantum states, yet extracting either quantity from large quantum circuits generally requires exponentially scaling resources. In diagrammatic approaches to quantum computation, such as the ZX-calculus, both quantities likewise typically require expensive tensor contractions that are not native to graphical rewriting. Here we show that both entanglement and magic can be efficiently estimated directly from ZX-diagrams. Flow enables efficient extraction of a normal form separating a potentially extensively entangled graph-state backbone from non-Clifford Pauli gadgets. This structure yields additive upper and lower bounds on bipartite entanglement entropy, which we further tighten through a preprocessing procedure that removes or merges redundant non-Clifford contributions. The same normal form gives an upper bound on logarithmic stabilizer extent. We benchmark these methods in random unitary and monitored circuits, and a circuit combining Trotterized Hamiltonian evolution with Clifford layers, finding that the resulting bounds remain informative even at large qubit numbers, circuit depths, and internal spider counts. Our results provide scalable probes of entanglement and non-stabilizerness of ZX-diagrams and establish a bridge between ZX-calculus and quantum many-body resource characterization, with applications across quantum computing, quantum information, and condensed-matter physics.
summary:
纠缠和非稳定剂是量子态复杂性背后的互补资源，但从大型量子电路中提取任一量通常需要指数级扩展的资源。在量子计算的图解方法中，例如 ZX 微积分，这两个量同样通常需要昂贵的张量收缩，而这对于图形重写来说并不是原生的。在这里，我们展示了可以直接从 ZX 图有效地估计纠缠和魔力。 Flow 能够有效地提取范式，将潜在广泛纠缠的图状态主干与非 Clifford Pauli 小工具分开。这种结构产生二分纠缠熵的加性上限和下限，我们通过预处理程序进一步收紧该上限和下限，该预处理程序删除或合并冗余的非 Clifford 贡献。相同的范式给出了对数稳定器范围的上限。

我们在随机单一和受监控电路以及将 Trotterized Hamiltonian 进化与 Clifford 层相结合的电路中对这些方法进行了基准测试，发现即使在大量子位数、电路深度和内部蜘蛛计数的情况下，所得界限仍然具有信息性。我们的结果提供了 ZX 图的纠缠和非稳定性的可扩展探针，并在 ZX 微积分和量子多体资源表征之间建立了一座桥梁，其应用遍及量子计算、量子信息和凝聚态物理。

title: On PPT entanglement distillation
abstract: We study entanglement distillation under operations that remain completely positive under partial-transpose conjugation, a.k.a. PPT channels, in the standard quantum Shannon theory regime of asymptotically vanishing but non-zero error. Our main results are: (a) a regularised formula for the PPT distillable entanglement in terms of a measured-relative-entropy-like quantity; and (b) two different single-letter converses, one based on operator quadratic forms and the other on Hirschman's strengthening of the Hadamard three-line theorem. As an immediate application of (b), we show that the PPT distillable entanglement can be strictly smaller than the regularised Rains bound, thereby resolving an open problem in the theory of entanglement manipulation [Regula et al., NJP 21:103017, 2019]. A gap appears already for $3\times 3$ Werner states: at antisymmetric weight $25/26$, a certified upper bound of $0.62107$ ebits lies below the (regularised) Rains bound, which equals $\frac{25}{26} \log_2 5 - \log_2 3 \approx 0.64766$ ebits. On a different note, (a) implies a faithful lower bound on the PPT distillable entanglement in terms of the entanglement negativity, which provides a quantitative counterpart to the qualitatively known fact that any NPT state is PPT distillable [Eggeling et al., PRL 87:257902, 2001].
summary:
我们研究了在渐近消失但非零误差的标准量子香农理论体系中，在部分转置共轭（又称 PPT 通道）下保持完全正值的操作下的纠缠蒸馏。我们的主要结果是：（a）用测量的相对熵类量表示 PPT 可蒸馏纠缠的正则化公式； (b) 两种不同的单字母逆算，一种基于算子二次形式，另一种基于赫希曼对哈达玛三线定理的强化。作为 (b) 的直接应用，我们证明 PPT 可蒸馏纠缠可以严格小于正则化 Rains 界限，从而解决了纠缠操纵理论中的一个开放问题 [Regula et al., NJP 21:103017, 2019]。 $3\times 3$ 已出现缺口 Werner 表示：在反对称权重 $25/26$ 下，经过认证的上限为 $0.62107$ 息税前利润低于（正规化）Rains 界限，等于 $\frac{25}{26} \log_2 5 - \log_2 3 \approx 0.64766$ 息税前利润。

另一方面，(a) 暗示了 PPT 可蒸馏纠缠在纠缠负性方面的忠实下界，这为任何 NPT 状态都是 PPT 可蒸馏的定性已知事实提供了定量对应物 [Eggeling 等人，PRL 87:257902, 2001]。
